facts.text: Look up high into the gentle blue sky after a soft spring shower. A giant, happy smile made of glowing colors stretches all the way across the clouds. It curves just like a banana or a smiling mouth saying hello to the whole world. Little children point their small fingers up and giggle at the bright, friendly bow. Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple beam down to tickle your nose. This big sky smile reminds everyone that sunny days always come back after the rain.

facts.title: Water Drops Acting Like Magic Prisms
facts.text: Tiny raindrops floating in the breezy air are actually wonderful little wizards in disguise. When warm sunbeams tickle these tiny water drops, something truly magical happens right before your eyes. The white sunshine breaks apart into a secret treasure box of hidden rainbow colors. Each little drop acts like a sparkling mirror bouncing light all around the playground. You can pretend you are a tiny fairy flying through a sparkling mist of liquid jewels.

facts.title: The Secret Sky Treasure Hunt
facts.text: Have you ever tried to run as fast as your little legs can carry you to find where a rainbow touches the ground? Grown-ups say there is a sparkly pot of gold hiding right at the very end of the colorful arch. You search behind the green garden bushes and past the big oak tree looking for shiny treasures. Even if you never quite reach the end, the chase is an exciting adventure for explorers. Every step is filled with giggles, fresh rainy smells, and the joy of running outside.

facts.title: A Cozy Blanket for the Backyard
facts.text: When the colorful rainbow paints the sky, the whole backyard looks like it is wrapped in a cozy, bright blanket. The wet grass sparkles like millions of tiny green diamonds resting softly on the ground. Flowers lift their sleepy heads up high to admire the pretty bridge stretching overhead. Butterflies flutter their painted wings to match the glowing reds and yellows in the clouds. Everything feels peaceful, clean, and brand new as nature wakes up from its refreshing shower nap.

facts.title: Painting with Invisible Sunshine Brushes
facts.text: Did you know that the sun has invisible paintbrushes made completely out of warm, golden light? It dips those magical brushes into the clouds and strokes the sky with vibrant colors. Red apples, orange carrots, yellow ducklings, green leaves, blue ponds, and purple grapes all share their hues. The rainbow is nature's way of finger painting on a giant blue canvas for everyone to see. You can grab your own crayons inside and draw your very own paper rainbow right now.

facts.title: The Sky's Colorful Hug
facts.text: Have you ever looked up after a gentle rain shower and seen a big, beautiful hug made of glowing colors in the sky? The lovely rainbow curves gently from one fluffy green tree all the way over to the other side of the neighborhood. It looks just like a giant colorful bridge made specially for little birds and busy bumblebees to walk across. When you put on your shiny yellow rain boots and look way up high, you can wave hello to all the pretty glowing bands. Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple smile right back down at your happy face.

facts.title: Sunlight Playing Dress Up
facts.text: Did you know that bright golden sunshine loves to play dress up when it is rainy outside? Invisible sunshine beams zoom down from the sky and tickle millions of tiny raindrops floating in the fresh air. As the sunbeams wiggle through the wet water drops, they change their plain clothes into sparkly red, yellow, and blue party dresses. It is just like shining a bright flashlight through a clean glass window and seeing shiny dancing stars on your bedroom wall. Nature's magic sunshine show turns ordinary raindrops into the most dazzling colors you have ever seen.

facts.title: A Rainbow's Cozy Water Drink
facts.text: Before a bright rainbow wakes up to paint the sky, the friendly clouds have to give the thirsty garden a big drink. Soft raindrops patter softly against the green grass, whispering gentle lullabies to sleepy flower seeds hiding in the dirt. Once the flowers have drank enough cool water to grow big and strong, the rain gently stops its song. Then the big bright sun comes out to say good morning, and together they weave a colorful rainbow ribbon in the sky. All the happy little plants stretch their green arms upward to admire the pretty colors.

facts.title: The Great Sky Treasure Hunt
facts.text: Looking for a rainbow is the most exciting treasure hunt you can ever play right in your own backyard. You do not need a treasure map or a magnifying glass to find this wonderful prize sparkling in the clouds. Just wait for a sunny day when raindrops and sunbeams decide to play a fun game of tag together. Turn around slowly with your arms open wide and search for the glowing red and blue curve hiding behind the trees. When you spot it, clap your hands with joy because you found nature's biggest and most beautiful treasure.

facts.title: Blinking Away the Storm
facts.text: Sometimes a rainy sky feels a little bit gloomy until a bouncy rainbow pops out to make everything feel cozy and bright. It is like the big sky is blinking away sleepy teardrops and replacing them with a cheerful smile full of lovely colors. Little fluffy bunnies in the meadow twitch their noses and hop around in the warm sunshine beneath the glowing arch. Even the puddles on the sidewalk start to sparkle with pink and green reflections like magic mirrors. Every single color in the rainbow tells a happy story about how wonderful rainy days can be.

facts.title: Tiny Mirror Raindrops
facts.text: Have you ever looked closely at a tiny drop of water? When the warm sunbeams peek through the fluffy grey clouds after a gentle spring shower, something magical happens. Millions of little raindrops float softly down through the fresh, clean air. Each round little droplet acts like a tiny, shiny mirror for the bright sunshine. The sunlight bounces right inside the water drop and turns into glittering ruby red, sunny yellow, and pretty sky blue. Thousands of these tiny mirror drops work together to paint a giant, colorful bridge high up in the blue sky just for you.

facts.title: A Soft Footbridge for Fluttering Butterflies
facts.text: Look way up high into the fluffy white clouds when the rain stops and the wind becomes gentle and calm. Do you see the lovely curved arch stretching across the bright blue sky? Some people whisper that it looks just like a soft, glowing footbridge made of colored silk. If tiny butterflies wanted to fly all the way up to the clouds, they could walk right across those glowing painted steps. It is a quiet, peaceful place where little birds love to sing their happy afternoon songs. Every time you spot this special sky bridge, remember that nature is sharing a secret, colorful smile with you.

facts.title: Drinking Sweet Rainwater Tea
facts.text: Down in the cozy garden, all the thirsty green leaves and sleepy little flowers are waking up with a big stretch. They love when the dark clouds bring a refreshing rain shower to wash their sleepy faces. After the storm passes and the colorful arch glows overhead, the plants take a long, happy sip of sweet rainwater. The bright colors from the sky seem to sprinkle right down into the soil to help the lovely red roses and yellow daisies grow tall and strong. You can put on your yellow rain boots and go outside to smell the fresh, damp earth while the garden drinks its afternoon tea.

facts.title: The Sky Showing All Its Favorite Crayons
facts.text: Sometimes the big blue sky gets tired of wearing just one plain color all day long. When the friendly sunbeams come out to play hide and seek with the passing rain clouds, the sky opens up its giant box of crayons. It draws a long, curving line of glowing red, bright orange, sunny yellow, grassy green, deep blue, and purple. Every single color shines as bright as a polished button on your favorite coat. The sky loves to show off all its favorite shades at once so little children down below can point up and giggle with pure joy.

facts.title: A Gentle Blanket After the Stormy Wind
facts.text: When the loud wind stops howling and blowing the trees around, the outdoor world becomes wonderfully quiet and peaceful. The air feels cool and crisp against your rosy cheeks as you step out onto the porch. Stretching across the horizon is a soft, comforting loop of glowing light that feels just like a warm, cozy blanket wrapping around the whole neighborhood. It tells us that the storm has gone away and everything is safe and calm again. You can take a deep breath of the clean, rainy air and smile up at the colorful canopy stretching from one side of the world to the other.

facts.title: A Great Big Sky Smile
facts.text: When the friendly sun shines brightly right after a soft, gentle rain shower, look way up high. A beautiful, curved rainbow stretches all across the fluffy clouds like a happy sky smile. Little toddlers love to point up and trace the shiny rainbow shape with their tiny fingers. It feels just like the sky is giving the whole wide world a warm and cozy hug. Every single color glows so brightly in the fresh afternoon air. Can you count all the pretty colors stretching from one side of the horizon to the other?

facts.title: Sunshine Playing Hide and Seek
facts.text: Did you know that bright sunshine is actually made of many hidden colors mixed all together? When golden sunbeams bump into tiny raindrops floating in the sky, the raindrops act like little magic windows. They gently catch the white sunshine and bend it into separate red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple ribbons. It is just like sunshine is playing an exciting game of hide and seek with the clouds. The little raindrops show off their secret colors for everyone to see in the afternoon sky.

facts.title: A Magical Footbridge for Butterflies
facts.text: When a bright rainbow appears after a spring rain, it looks just like a giant, glowing slide made of pure light. Soft fluttery butterflies resting on green leaves might pretend the rainbow is a magical colored footbridge. They can dance across the sky from one fluffy cloud to another in their delightful games. Sweet little birds fly right underneath the colorful arch and sing happy springtime songs to the fresh air. Everything in nature feels so sparkly, clean, and full of wonderful magic whenever the rainbow visits.

facts.title: Drinking Sweet Rainwater Tea
facts.text: Down below on the cozy ground, pretty garden flowers wake up feeling very thirsty after a busy rainstorm. They look up at the glorious rainbow arching overhead while drinking up sweet rainwater through their green stems. Little friendly frogs sitting near the garden pond splash their webbed feet in puddles and watch the colors glow. The thirsty roots whisper thank you to the clouds for bringing such a refreshing and delicious drink. Every plant and flower wears shiny raindrop jewels that sparkle right underneath the magnificent rainbow colors.

facts.title: The Sky Showing Its Favorite Crayons
facts.text: Imagine if the giant blue sky had a huge box of colorful crayons and wanted to draw a masterpiece. A brilliant rainbow is just like the sky opening its box to show everyone its absolute favorite shades. There is glowing red like a sweet strawberry, bright yellow like a warm dandelion, and deep blue like the ocean. Toddlers can put on their yellow rain boots, step outside, and pretend to paint along with the clouds. It is such a delightful treat to watch the gentle colors slowly fade away until the next rainy day.

facts.title: Painting the Puddles
facts.text: Have you ever looked down at a big puddle after the rain stops? Sometimes, happy little rainbows like to go swimming right down there in the water! If you look very closely, you can see shiny red, pretty yellow, and bright blue shimmering in the puddle. The friendly sunbeams tickle the wet street and make dancing colors appear at your feet. You can wear your yellow rain boots and splash gently right next to the little water rainbow. It is just like having a pocket-sized magical painting right on the ground for you to visit.

facts.title: A Blanket for the Busy Bees
facts.text: When a bright rainbow stretches across the sky, tired little honeybees know it is time to dry their fuzzy wings. The warm sunshine comes out to say hello and warms up the cozy garden flowers after the storm. Bees fly from petal to petal, drinking sweet nectar while looking up at the beautiful colorful arch above them. Everything smells so fresh and clean, like wet green leaves and happy springtime dirt. The flowers drink up the raindrops and smile up at the glowing rainbow bridge in the big sky.

facts.title: The Sleepy Cloud's Blanket
facts.text: Did you know that rainbows are like cozy, colorful blankets that tuck the sleepy storm clouds in for a nap? After the big grey clouds rumble and drop their heavy raindrops, they feel very tired and ready to rest. The bright sun comes out and drapes a gorgeous, glowing rainbow right across their sleepy shoulders. The grey clouds turn fluffy and white again as they float away on a gentle breeze. You can look up, wave goodbye to the stormy clouds, and whisper sweet dreams to the colorful sky.

facts.title: A Slide for the Little Songbirds
facts.text: Imagine a big, beautiful playground slide made entirely out of shimmering red, green, and purple light! Little robins and chirpy bluebirds love to pretend the rainbow is a wonderful slide reaching across the fluffy clouds. After singing their happy post-rain songs, they flutter their wings and dance along the bright colors in the sky. The warm sunbeams make the rainbow slide sparkle like glitter for all the feathered friends to see. You can stretch your arms up high and pretend you are sliding down the soft, glowing colors right along with the birds.

facts.title: Catching Whispers of Light
facts.text: When a lovely rainbow appears, it brings quiet whispers of magic straight from the happy sunshine and the floating clouds. If you stand very still in your backyard and take a big, deep breath, you can smell how clean and sweet the air is. The rainbow is like a giant glowing hug wrapping around the entire world to make everyone feel warm and safe. You can close your eyes, make a gentle wish on the glowing colors, and keep the bright happiness in your heart all day long.

facts.title: A Shiny Sunbeam Party
facts.text: Did you know a rainbow happens when happy sunbeams love to play with raindrops in the sky? When the bright sun shines through little floating water drops after a gentle storm, magic happens right above our heads. Tiny drops of rain act like tiny windows that catch the warm sunshine. They bounce the bright light all around and turn it into glowing colors. You can wave your hands up high and say hello to the shiny sunbeam party dancing in the clouds.

facts.title: Bouncing Light in the Air
facts.text: Have you ever looked closely at a glass of sparkly water on your kitchen table? When the sunshine hits the water just right, little dancing lights bounce onto your wall. That is exactly how a giant rainbow is made way up high in the sky. Millions of tiny raindrops act like little mirrors catching the sunbeams. They bounce the light back and forth until it stretches out into a long, beautiful ribbon of colors for us to see.

facts.title: The Sky Wears a Colorful Bow
facts.text: After a soft rain shower washes the green leaves and thirsty flowers, the sky likes to dress up too. It puts on a giant, curved arch that looks just like a bright, happy bow. This colorful ribbon stretches all the way from one side of the horizon to the other. Little birds singing in the trees stop to look up at the lovely painted curve. We can put on our shiny yellow rain boots and step outside to admire the sky's special decoration.

facts.title: Happy Flowers Drinking Rainbows
facts.text: When the colorful rainbow glows in the sky, all the little flowers in the garden feel extra happy. They just finished taking a long, cool drink of rainwater from the friendly gray clouds. Now they look up at the bright painted arch and giggle in the gentle breeze. The green stems reach up tall to catch the warm, cozy sunshine hugging the ground. Every little daisy and tulip knows that a rainbow means the garden is fresh and ready to grow.

facts.title: Chasing the Glowing Colors
facts.text: Have you ever tried to run outside and touch the lovely glowing rainbow curving through the air? Even though we run as fast as our little legs can carry us, the rainbow always stays far away. That is because it is made of pure sunshine and mist playing together in the sky. It is a magical present just to look at with our wide-open eyes and big smiles. We can take a deep breath of the fresh, clean air and wave goodbye to our colorful friend.

facts.title: A Rainbow Hugs the Green Grass
facts.text: Have you ever wondered where a big bright rainbow goes when it stretches all the way down from the sky? It tickles the tops of the tall green trees and whispers hello to the soft grass below. The glowing colors wrap around the world like a warm, cozy hug after a busy rainy day. Little bunny rabbits hop out from their hiding spots to look up at the magical glowing arch. They wiggle their cute little noses and watch the pretty red, yellow, and blue light sparkle. It feels like the whole wide earth is smiling right back at the gentle sunshine in the sky.

facts.title: Dancing Through the Shiny Mist
facts.text: Imagine standing in your yard with the warm garden hose splashing tiny water drops everywhere in the air. If you turn around and face away from the bright sun, you might see your very own mini rainbow dance! Little sparkling droplets of water act like tiny magnifying glasses for all the sunbeams shining down. They catch the golden light and bounce it back out as a secret ring of pretty pastel colors. You can reach out your little hands and pretend to tickle the floating rainbow mist while you giggle. Playing outside in the shimmering backyard sunshine is just about the most magical adventure a curious toddler can ever have.

facts.title: A Cozy Bridge for Little Ladybugs
facts.text: When a colorful rainbow appears after a soft spring shower, it looks just like a giant curvy slide for tiny bugs. Little spotted ladybugs crawl up onto a shiny green leaf and look way up at the painted sky. They wonder if they can climb the red and orange stripes to visit the fluffy white clouds way up high. The friendly sun warms their little red shells while they rest and watch the pretty light show overhead. Everything smells so fresh and clean after the rain kisses the dirt and the flowers. It is such a happy time for all the tiny creatures to come outside and stretch their legs.

facts.title: Singing a Song of Many Colors
facts.text: Listen very closely when the rain stops and the big bright rainbow pops out to play in the clouds. Little yellow birds sitting high in the branches start to sing their happiest springtime songs of all. Every single color in the rainbow sounds like a different musical note to their cheerful little ears. Red is a loud tweet, yellow is a sunny chirp, and blue is a gentle whistle in the breeze. The birds flutter their wings together and celebrate the wonderful weather with a sweet melody just for you. Singing along with the colorful sky makes your heart feel as light as a floating feather in the wind.

facts.title: The Sky Showing Off Its Best Dress
facts.text: Sometimes the big blue sky likes to put on a fancy dress made entirely out of glowing rainbow stripes. It slowly walks across the clouds like a friendly dancer showing off its favorite shiny new outfit to everyone. Toddlers point their little fingers up high and count all the wonderful colors hiding inside the magical sky blanket. There is ruby red, sunshine yellow, leafy green, and deep ocean blue all blended together in a wonderful row. It stays there for just a little while before slowly melting away into the warm evening sunset. Every single time the colorful sky dress appears, it brings a giant smile to your face.

facts.title: Tiny Sky Stars
facts.text: Have you ever looked closely at a tiny snowflake falling from the cold winter sky? Each little flake is shaped just like a magical six-pointed star made of frozen water. They float softly down through the chilly air like tiny feathers dancing in the wind. If you catch one on your warm red mitten, you can see its beautiful pointy design. No two snowflakes are ever exactly alike, which makes every single one a special surprise. They pile up together to cover the sleeping ground in a blanket of glittering white.

facts.title: Winter's Cozy Coat
facts.text: When the weather turns very cold and snow arrives, nature puts on a big white winter coat. The bright green grass and sleepy brown trees are tucked underneath a soft, fluffy layer of white snow. This chilly blanket actually helps keep the sleeping plants safe and warm until springtime comes again. The whole world looks quiet and peaceful like a giant painting made of sparkles. Everything is painted in shades of glowing white and bright silver under the pale winter sunbeams.

facts.title: Dressed for Snowflake Fun
facts.text: Playing outside in the snow is so much fun when you wear your cozy winter clothes. First, you pull on your thick woolen mittens to keep your fingers warm and happy. Then you zip up your puffy jacket and step into your tall boots for walking in the drifts. When you walk, your boots make a loud crunch-crunch sound in the packed white powder. You can stretch out your arms and make big snow angels by moving your arms and legs. Dressing warmly lets you play outside all day long without feeling chilly.

facts.title: Animal Snow Tracks
facts.text: Did you know that snowy days leave behind secret puzzles for us to solve? When furry animals walk across the soft white ground, they leave little footprint stamps behind. A tiny bird leaves little dashes, and a scampering squirrel leaves four cute dots in the powder. If you look closely, you can follow these mysterious animal tracks across your yard. It is like reading a storybook written by the forest creatures who are looking for snacks. The snow tells us who has been exploring while we were sleeping inside.

facts.title: Rolling a Snow Friend
facts.text: When the sun shines and the snow becomes sticky and wet, it is time to build a snowman. You scoop up a handful of white powder and roll it into a little ball. As you push it across the yard, the snowball picks up more snow and grows bigger and bigger. Soon you have a giant round base for your very own snowy friend to stand on. You can add a carrot for a nose and two buttons for happy eyes. Building together in the cold winter air brings giant smiles to everyone.

facts.title: Dancing Snowflakes in the Air
facts.text: Look up at the soft gray winter clouds, little explorer! Tiny water drops high in the sky get very cold and turn into magical ice crystals. They grow six pointy little arms, just like tiny stars floating down to earth. Each sparkly snowflake dances and twirls in the chilly breeze on its way down. If you catch one gently on your warm red mitten, you can see its pretty patterns before it melts. It is just like magic falling right from the sky.

facts.title: A Blanket for Sleeping Trees
facts.text: When winter comes around, the tall green trees and sleepy garden plants need to stay nice and warm. A thick blanket of fluffy white snow covers the ground like a giant duvet. This chilly white blanket protects little roots resting underground from the cold winds. The sleeping trees rest quietly all season long while they wait for spring. When the warm sunbeams finally arrive, the snowy blanket melts away to help them wake up and grow.

facts.title: Crunchy Footsteps on the Path
facts.text: Step outside into the winter wonderland and listen very closely with your little ears. Every time your boots press down on the fresh snow, it makes a happy crunching sound. Crunch, crunch, crunch goes your walk along the sparkling white pathway! Millions of tiny ice crystals are gently whispering hello beneath your toes. Leaving your footprints in the blank white yard is like drawing a special picture for the world to see.

facts.title: Quiet World of the White Season
facts.text: Have you ever noticed how wonderfully quiet the world is after a big snowstorm? The thick blanket of fluffy white flakes acts like a giant soft pillow for the whole neighborhood. It catches loud sounds and turns them into quiet whispers. The busy streets are still, and the birds are resting cozily in their hidden nests. You can hear the gentle wind blowing softly through the frosted trees in this peaceful winter playground.

facts.title: Sparkling Diamond Sunshine
facts.text: When the sun peeks out after a snowy day, something truly magical happens all around you. Millions of tiny snowflakes on the ground and trees begin to sparkle like real diamonds. The whole world shines bright and glowing in the crisp morning light. You might need to shade your sleepy eyes from all that dazzling white glitter. It looks as though a fairy sprinkled sparkly magic dust across the entire neighborhood just for you.

facts.title: Chilly Cloud Drops
facts.text: Look way up high into the cold winter sky where fluffy gray clouds float by. The wind blows a gentle breeze, making tiny raindrops freeze into magical little ice crystals. These special drops tumble down together to form soft, white snow flurries. When you watch them fall, it looks like feathers floating from heaven. Every single flake swirls around before landing softly on your red mitten. Isn't it wonderful how the chilly sky creates such a delightful frozen treat for us to see?

facts.title: Whispering Frozen Wind
facts.text: Listen very closely when the white season arrives to hear the frosty wind whisper a secret song. It swoops down from the mountains and gently blows across the sleepy meadows. The breeze carries tiny ice sparkles through the air like invisible fairies dancing in a circle. When it touches your rosy cheeks, it feels wonderfully cool and crisp. You can wrap your cozy wool scarf tight and giggle as the wind tries to tickle your nose. Nature loves to share her musical breath with every little explorer outside.

facts.title: Winter Drink for Thirsty Roots
facts.text: Deep underneath the cold white ground, sleepy tree roots take a long and peaceful winter nap. The thick blanket of snow keeps them warm and cozy while the rest of the world rests. When the bright sunbeams finally shine down, the little snowflakes melt into cool water drops. This gentle moisture trickles down through the soil to give the thirsty roots a lovely drink. Soon enough, those sleepy trees will wake up and grow bright green leaves again. Mother Nature takes care of all her leafy friends even on the coldest days.

facts.title: Catching a Diamond Star
facts.text: Hold out your hand and catch a falling snowflake right on your dark sleeve. If you look very, very closely with your bright eyes, you will see a tiny shining star. Every single snowflake is shaped like a delicate little jewel made of pure ice. No two stars in the whole wide world look exactly the same! They are like tiny frozen surprises sent just for you to admire. Before you can even count to three, the warm little speck might tickle your palm and turn into a tiny water drop.

facts.title: Snug in Warm Wool
facts.text: When the frosty weather arrives, it is time to put on your favorite cozy clothes for a fun outdoor adventure. First, pull on your stretchy yellow wool socks and your thickest winter boots. Next comes a puffy red jacket and fuzzy mittens that keep your fingers warm and happy. Do not forget a long colorful scarf to wrap around your neck like a warm hug. Being dressed up so nicely means you can play outside all day long without feeling chilly. Get ready to explore the magical wonderland while staying as snug as a bug.

facts.title: Painting the World White
facts.text: Have you ever looked outside your bedroom window and seen a magical white world? When the sky gets very chilly, tiny water drops turn into soft little flakes. They float down gently like feathers from the clouds. The whole playground and the tall trees get covered in a sparkling white blanket. Everything looks so clean, bright, and brand new. Let us step outside together and watch the wonderful snow paint the world.

facts.title: Music Under Our Boots
facts.text: When the fluffy snow falls all over the ground, it makes a special sound just for you. As you walk outside in your big winter boots, you can hear a happy crunch, crunch, crunch. The tiny ice crystals under your feet are whispering hello to your toes. Each step sounds like music playing in the frosty air. Walking on a snowy path is like playing a fun song with your feet all morning long.

facts.title: Snug and Warm Inside
facts.text: When the wind blows cold snow outside, it is time to be cozy inside our warm home. We can wrap ourselves in soft blankets that feel like a big furry hug. Drinking a cup of warm milk makes our tummies feel so happy and safe. We can sit by the window and watch the pretty flakes dance past the glass. Being cozy inside makes the snowy winter days feel extra special and full of love.

facts.title: The Sleepy Forest
facts.text: Did you know that snowy days help the tall trees take a long winter nap? When the cold weather arrives, the trees rest because they do not have any green leaves to hold. The white snow acts like a thick, cozy quilt keeping their roots nice and warm. They sleep all through the chilly season and dream about spring flowers. When the warm sun comes back later, the sleepy trees will wake up again.

facts.title: Little Animal Paw Prints
facts.text: When fresh snow covers the ground, it becomes a giant storybook for curious little eyes. Walking outside, we can see tiny footprints left behind by furry forest friends. A little bunny or a hopping bird visited the yard while we were sleeping. Their cute tracks tell us where they went on their chilly morning adventures. Can you guess which animal made those lovely little marks in the snow today?

facts.title: Tiny Little Ice Feathers
facts.text: Have you ever looked closely at a tiny snow crystal falling from the sky? High up in the chilly gray clouds, water drops freeze into magical little shapes with six points. Every single snowflake looks like a tiny starry ice feather dancing in the wind. When they tumble down together, they catch the bright sunlight and sparkle like millions of little diamonds. You can catch one on your warm red mitten and look at its pretty patterns before it tickles away. Nature makes every single snowflake completely different, just like you are special and one of a kind.

facts.title: Winter Breath and Frosty Air
facts.text: When you step outside on a very cold snowy morning, try taking a big deep breath through your nose. Whoosh, the air feels super chilly and tickles your nose like tiny mint leaves. When you breathe out into the frosty air, something magical happens right in front of your face. Little puffs of warm white steam float up into the sky like friendly little ghosts playing tag. Your cozy body is making its own warm weather inside your puffy winter coat. It is so much fun to watch your breathing turn into friendly little clouds on a freezing day.

facts.title: Building a Cold Bumpy Friend
facts.text: When heavy white snow covers the ground in a thick and fluffy layer, it loves to stick together. If you scoop up a big handful of cold white powder and squeeze it tight, it packs into a heavy ball. Rolling that ball through the yard picks up more and more snow until it grows as big as a sleeping bear. You can stack a medium ball on top to make a smiling tummy and a small ball for a friendly head. Give your cold white friend two funny twig arms and a carrot nose to watch over your snowy playground all day long.

facts.title: The Big White Sound Sleep
facts.text: Listen very closely when you walk outside right after a heavy snowstorm has finished falling everywhere. Everything in the big wide world sounds so wonderfully peaceful, quiet, and soft. The deep snow blanket acts like a giant fluffy pillow that wraps around the trees and houses. It catches loud noises and muffles them so the whole neighborhood feels like it is taking a cozy nap. Even the big noisy trucks driving down the street sound quiet and far away. It is a wonderful time to whisper secrets to your friends while the sleepy world listens along.

facts.title: Winter Mittens and Hot Cocoa
facts.text: After playing outside in the frosty white snow for a long time, your fingers might feel a little bit cold. That is the special signal to march right back inside your warm house with happy stomping boots. Shed your wet jacket and slide your hands into soft, fuzzy, brightly colored woolly mittens to chase the chill away. Then you can wrap your palms around a big mug of warm chocolate milk with floating white marshmallows on top. Sitting by the window watching the snowy flakes tumble down while you sip something sweet feels so wonderfully safe and snug.

facts.title: Dancing Cold Little Clouds
facts.text: Have you ever wondered where snowflakes come from way up high in the sky? High up in the chilly winter clouds, tiny drops of water turn into little bits of ice. They tumble and dance together in the cold wind, growing arms and points like tiny little stars. When they are big and fluffy, they float softly down to the ground. You can stretch out your hand and watch them land on your sleeve. They are so light and delicate like feathers falling from the sky. Look closely with your eyes and see how every single little star looks different.

facts.title: Tickly Cold on My Nose
facts.text: Stepping outside on a snowy day feels like entering a giant wonderland made of sparkling sugar. The air feels cool and crisp against your rosy cheeks when you take a big breath. When snowflakes fall all around you, they tickle your nose when they land gently on the tip. You can open your mouth wide and try to catch a tiny snowflake on your tongue. It tastes just like cold water before it melts away into a little giggle. Being outside in the cold weather makes you want to run and play in the big fluffy white blankets.

facts.title: Sleeping Under a White Blanket
facts.text: When winter arrives with lots of snow, the big trees and sleeping plants get a very special bedtime story. The heavy white snow falls all around the forest and tucks the grass in for a long winter rest. It is like a big cozy white quilt keeping the sleeping garden warm underneath. Little woodland animals like fuzzy bears and sleepy frogs rest safely in their cozy homes. They curl up tight and dream sweet dreams while the snow falls quietly outside their doors. Nature is resting now so it can wake up strong and green again in the spring.

facts.title: Crunchy Shoes on the White Path
facts.text: Walking outside after a snowstorm makes the most wonderful crunching sounds right under your boots. Every time you take a big step, your boots make a happy crunch sound in the snow. It is like the ground is singing a special song just for you and your feet. You can look behind you and see your big footprints marching all the way across the yard. Your puppy or kitty might leave little round paw prints right next to your shoes. Playing outside lets you make your very own snowy path where no one has walked before.

facts.title: Cozy Warm Cup After Play
facts.text: After playing outside in the cold white snow for a long time, it is time to get cozy and warm. You can take off your wet boots and hang up your cold mittens by the door. Slipping into fuzzy warm socks and a soft sweater feels so wonderful on your chilly toes. Sitting with your family while holding a mug of warm milk makes you feel safe inside. Outside the window, the snow continues to fall in the quiet and peaceful evening. You feel happy and warm as you rest your sleepy head after a big day of snowy adventures.

facts.title: Tiny Sky Stars
facts.text: Have you ever looked really closely at a tiny white snowflake falling from the cold gray sky? Every single snowflake is shaped just like a sparkly little star with six pointy arms. High up in the chilly clouds, water drops freeze together into magical geometric shapes. No two snowflakes in the whole wide world look exactly the same. When they float down softly, they cover the ground in millions of tiny stars. You can catch them on your red mitten to see their pretty patterns before they melt. Isn't it wonderful how the sky sends us sparkling starry treasures to play with all winter long?

facts.title: Winter Shimmer Dust
facts.text: When the sun finally peeks out after a big snowstorm, the whole backyard turns into a glittering wonderland. Millions of tiny ice crystals catch the bright morning sunshine and sparkle like real diamonds. If you walk across the yard, the snowy ground looks like it is covered in magic shimmer dust. The bright white light bounces all around and makes everything look super clean and shiny. Squint your eyes just a little bit and watch the whole world glow in the chilly morning light. It feels like living inside a fairy tale where every tree branch wears a sparkling crown of light.

facts.title: The Big White Hug
facts.text: Did you know that a thick blanket of winter snow acts like a big warm hug for the sleeping earth? When the temperature drops outside, deep underneath the white snow is actually cozy and safe. The fluffy snow traps tiny pockets of air that keep the sleeping grass and tiny plant roots protected from the bitter wind. Little seeds and sleepy bugs can rest comfortably beneath the heavy white quilt until spring arrives. Nature knows just how to tuck everything in for a long winter nap. When we look at the quiet snowy fields, we are seeing nature's very own cozy bedroom.

facts.title: Whispering Winter Wind
facts.text: Listen very carefully when the cold winter wind blows gently across the snowy hills outside your window. The wind makes a soft whistling sound as it dances through the bare tree branches. It loves to pick up loose white snowflakes and spin them around in a dizzy little dance. Sometimes the blowing snow creates little sparkly waves that look just like ocean foam. If you stand bundled up on the porch, you can feel the chilly breeze tickling your rosy cheeks. The wind is simply singing a sleepy winter lullaby to help the resting forest stay calm and peaceful.

facts.title: Melting Spring Puddles
facts.text: When wintertime starts to say goodbye, warm golden sunbeams come out to play in the sky. The friendly sun warms up the chilly air and makes the big white snowbanks start to sweat. Slowly, tiny drops of water begin to slide down the side of every snowy hill. They make happy little trickling sounds as they run together to form fun splashing puddles. Little robins and sparrows love to splash around in these fresh puddles of melted snow. It is nature's way of turning the winter playground into a refreshing drink for thirsty spring flowers.

facts.title: Tiny Sky Feather Crystals
facts.text: High up in the cold sky, tiny raindrops turn into magical little ice stars. These little frozen stars have six pointy arms just like tiny feathers. They gently float down through the air like sleepy white butterflies. When they land right on your warm little glove, you can see them shine. They are so tiny and delicate that they tickle your fingers with a soft touch. Every single one in the whole wide world looks completely different.

facts.title: Crunchy Boot Steps
facts.text: When the white powder covers the grass, it makes a very special sound when you walk. Every time you take a big step in your warm boots, you hear a happy crunch sound. Crunch, crunch, crunch go your feet on the chilly ground. It is like walking on top of a big box of crispy crackers. Your little footsteps leave behind long trails of bumpy tracks in the yard. You can follow your own fun path all the way back to the door.

facts.title: Winter Tree Pajamas
facts.text: Tall green trees get very sleepy when the chilly winter weather comes to visit. They drop all their colorful autumn leaves to take a long winter rest. Then, a soft white coat falls down from the clouds to tuck them in. The fluffy snow sits gently on every single brown branch like a heavy blanket. The trees stay fast asleep and cozy under their white covers all season long. They dream sweet dreams until the warm spring sun wakes them up.

facts.title: Catching Cold Star Kisses
facts.text: Look way up high into the gray sky where the little white flakes are born. Open your mouth wide and stick out your tongue just a tiny bit. Close your eyes and wait for a gentle sky kiss to land. A tiny cold flake will float right down and touch your tongue. It feels so cool and tickly for just one second before it disappears. It tastes just like a cool sip of fresh water straight from a cloud.

facts.title: Snowy Animal Footprint Secrets
facts.text: The white ground acts like a giant storytelling page for our woodland animal friends. When little bunnies and birds walk around, they leave funny little marks behind. You can see tiny paw prints hopping across the smooth white yard. A tiny bird might leave little star tracks near the old wooden fence. It is like a secret puzzle showing where the animals went for a walk. We can follow the funny tracks and guess which furry friend made them.

facts.title: Sparkling Diamond Blankets
facts.text: When the friendly sky clouds get super chilly, they turn tiny water drops into glittering white snow. These sparkling bits tumble gently down and cover the whole sleepy world. When the warm morning sunbeam says hello, the snow starts to shine like a million tiny diamonds. Everything looks bright, clean, and magical outside your window. You can step outside and watch the whole neighborhood sparkle in the gentle winter light.

facts.title: Woolly Mitten Hugs
facts.text: Playing in the cold white snow is so much fun, but your fingers need to stay nice and cozy. Before you run outside to catch the falling flakes, put on your colorful woolly mittens. They give your hands a soft, warm hug while you build giant snow mountains. You can still pat the cold white snow and make big snowballs easily. Keeping your fingers warm means you can play outside all morning long with a happy smile.

facts.title: Busy Animal Track Detectives
facts.text: A fresh layer of white snow turns the quiet backyard into a giant storybook page. Little furry woodland animals walk across the soft white ground to look for tasty treats. They leave behind funny little footprints that look just like tiny dots and dashes. You can crouch down low and follow the mysterious animal tracks like a friendly detective. Can you guess which clever little bunny or curious bird made those sweet little marks in the snow?

facts.title: Gentle White Tree Pajamas
facts.text: When the weather gets very cold, tall leafy trees need to take a long winter nap. The gentle falling snow wraps thick, soft white pajamas all around their bare wooden branches. The sleepy trees rest quietly under their heavy winter blankets until the warm spring sun comes back. The snow keeps the resting plants safe and cozy all through the chilly season. Everything in nature is resting peacefully until it is time to wake up again.

facts.title: Sweet Hot Cocoa Warmers
facts.text: After playing outside in the chilly wind and glittering snow, your tummy feels ready for something special. Come right inside the warm, cozy kitchen and take off your heavy boots. Mommy or Daddy pours a cup of warm, sweet hot cocoa with a floating marshmallow on top. You wrap both hands around the warm mug and feel the cozy heat spread through your fingers. It is the most comforting way to end a wonderful snowy day of outdoor adventure.

facts.title: Cloud Cold Magic
facts.text: High up in the sky, fluffy gray clouds hold tiny drops of water. When the air up there gets extra chilly, those water drops turn into magic little ice sparkles. They bump and tumble together inside the cloud until they grow heavy. Then, they float down through the air like tiny floating feathers. You can look up at the gray sky and watch them dance. It feels like the clouds are sending us a magical white hello.

facts.title: Glittering White Sparkles
facts.text: When you step outside on a snowy morning, the whole world looks like it is covered in glitter. Millions of tiny snow crystals catch the bright morning sunbeams. They shine and twinkle just like diamonds hidden in the grass. If you look very closely with your magnifying glass, you can see their pretty little shapes. Everything is painted in the most beautiful, shiny white color. It is a wonderful sparkling wonderland made just for you to explore.

facts.title: Cozy Woolly Mitten Hugs
facts.text: Playing in the cold snow is so much fun, but we have to keep our fingers warm and happy. Before we go outside to catch snowflakes, we pull on our thickest woolly mittens. They feel soft and cozy, like a gentle hug for every single finger. With our warm mittens on, we can safely scoop up the chilly snow. We can pat it and squeeze it to build a wonderful round snowman. Staying bundled up in warm clothes keeps our adventures happy and cozy all day long.

facts.title: Crunchy Footstep Music
facts.text: Have you ever heard the special song that fresh snow plays when you walk on it? When you step down in your warm winter boots, the snow makes a funny crunch-crunch sound. It sounds just like someone is chewing on a crispy celery stick. Every single step you take leaves a deep footprint shape behind you. You can walk in a straight line or make wiggly paths across the yard. Your feet are making happy little music all around the snowy playground.

facts.title: Sleeping Tree Pajamas
facts.text: When the cold winter weather arrives, all the tall green trees get ready for a long winter sleep. They drop their colorful leaves to rest their branches until springtime comes again. Then, gentle snow falls all over their sleepy branches like a soft, fluffy blanket. The white snow acts like cozy pajamas keeping the trees warm and snug. The trees stand very still and quiet while they dream sweet dreams. They are resting peacefully until the warm sun wakes them up next year.

facts.title: The Big Sky Drum
facts.text: Have you ever heard a loud rumble hiding way up high in the fluffy gray clouds? That deep sound is called thunder, and it is just like the sky playing a giant drum. When friendly warm air and cool breezes play together up high, they make big bumping noises. You do not need to feel scared of the loud sky drum at all. Snuggle up with your favorite soft blanket and listen to the music of the weather. Soon the noisy drum will roll away and leave the air feeling fresh and clean.

facts.title: Bright Sparkles in the Sky
facts.text: Look out your window when the weather gets busy to see a quick flash of light. That bright sparkle is called lightning, and it dances across the clouds like a giant glowing zig-zag. It is just nature turning on a sparkly light show way up high in the sky. The bright flash happens super fast before hiding right back inside the puffy gray blanket of clouds. When you see the magical sparkle, you can give a big wave to the sky. It is just the clouds sharing their wonderful glowing energy with our big wide world.

facts.title: Yellow Boots Ready
facts.text: When the stormy clouds bring lots of water down to the ground, it is time for a fun outdoor adventure. Pull on your bright yellow rain boots and zip up your cozy waterproof coat right to the top. Splishing and splashing in big puddles is one of the best ways to enjoy a rainy stormy day. Every little froggy in the garden loves the wet weather and sings happy songs in the grass. You can catch cool raindrops on your nose while the sky rumbles gently far away. Dressing up warm and cozy makes rainy weather feel like pure magic for explorers.

facts.title: Flowers Drinking Deeply
facts.text: All the thirsty flowers and tall green trees get very excited when the sky starts to rumble and roar. The loud thunder tells the friendly rain clouds that it is time to open up and share their water. Gulp, gulp, goes the garden as cool, refreshing raindrops fall softly onto every little leaf and petal. The happy plants take big drinks of water so they can grow tall and show off their pretty colors. Next time you hear thunder, remember it is just helping the thirsty flowers take a nice long bath. Nature works together in wonderful ways to keep every living thing healthy and strong.

facts.title: The Sun Comes Back
facts.text: After the loud thunder finishes its big rumble and the bright lightning goes to sleep, something wonderful happens outside. The big warm sunbeams peek right back out through the parting gray clouds to say hello. Sometimes you can even spot a gorgeous rainbow stretching high across the sky with all its pretty colors. The world smells so fresh and clean after a busy storm has washed the air. Birds start to sing happy little songs from the branches of the trees once again. Every little storm always goes away, leaving a bright and sunny day behind for us to enjoy.

facts.title: The Puffiest Giant Clouds
facts.text: Have you ever looked way up high and seen giant, fluffy grey pillows resting in the sky? Those are special weather clouds that love to carry lots of heavy raindrops inside their bellies. As they float together and play tag in the wind, they start to grow very big and tall like mountains. They look a little bit sleepy and snuggly, but they are getting ready for a wonderful sky adventure. Soon, they will tickle each other and share all their cool water with the thirsty grass down below. Can you stretch your arms up high and puff out your cheeks just like a big fluffy storm cloud?

facts.title: The Great Sky Light Show
facts.text: Suddenly, when the big clouds are full and bouncy, a super fast flicker of light dances across the window. Zip, zap, zoom! It looks just like a giant glowing wiggle worm or a sparkly firework high up in the air. This bright flash happens when sleepy sky energy wakes up and stretches its arms in a flash. It lasts for just a tiny second before hiding away again like a game of peek-a-boo. You can curl up safe and cozy inside your blanket while you watch the magical glowing colors light up your bedroom wall.

facts.title: Rumble Bumbles in the Air
facts.text: Right after the bright sparkle flashes, do you hear that deep, sleepy noise rolling through the sky? Boom, rumble, rumble goes the big giant voice high up in the clouds. It sounds just like a friendly bear snoring or heavy wooden blocks tumbling down on the rug. That wonderful noise is simply the air waking up and making a big, happy yawn after the bright light show. There is nothing to fear at all because the sky is just playing a musical song for you. You can give a silly little rumble right back to the clouds and giggle at the sound.

facts.title: Fresh Rain on Friendly Leaves
facts.text: When the storm starts to whisper and dance, it brings a very special, clean smell to the whole wide world. Take a big, deep breath through your nose and smell the wonderful wet earth and sleepy garden plants. The little green leaves on the trees are clapping their hands because they are getting a nice, cool shower. Flowers wiggle their stems and smile up at the sky while they drink up all the yummy water. Every little bug and bird finds a cozy spot to hide and rest while the wonderful rain washes the world clean.

facts.title: The Gentle Rainbow Goodbye
facts.text: As soon as the bright flashes and sleepy rumbles finish their game, the big heavy clouds start to float away. Then, the warm sunbeams peek back out from behind the edges to say hello to everyone again. Look way across the sky and see what colorful surprise appears just for you. A gorgeous, smiling rainbow stretches all the way from one side of the earth to the other side. Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple stripes paint the sky like a magical bridge made of pure joy.

facts.title: The Sky Blanket Warm-Up
facts.text: Have you ever wondered how thunder gets started up high in the cozy clouds? The friendly sun shines down warm rays and tickles the sky with golden heat. High up in the air, warm puffy clouds bump into cool breezes playing tag. This happy wiggle and hug makes a big secret energy pop inside the cloud. When the happy cloud gets too full, it says rumble-rumble to let us know it is stretching. It is just the sky taking a big sleepy yawn and getting ready for a fresh drink. You are safe inside your warm home listening to the sky's sleepy music.

facts.title: Lightning Bug Sparks
facts.text: Look out your window and see the quick flash dance across the sleepy nighttime sky. Tiny invisible helpers inside the giant rain cloud play a game of tag with glowing sparkles. They chase each other round and round until ZAP, a bright pencil of light draws a picture. It is faster than a blinking frog catching a yummy fly on a lily pad. The shiny flash lights up your bedroom walls for just one happy little second. Then it goes dark again so you can snuggle deeper into your soft blankets and dream sweet dreams.

facts.title: Hiding Like Field Mice
facts.text: When the loud thunder rumbles and the bright lightning flashes, our animal friends know just what to do. Little brown bunnies hop super fast into their cozy underground holes away from the big noise. Fuzzy bumblebees tuck their sleepy wings underneath soft flower petals to stay nice and dry. Even the little tree frogs stop their singing and snuggle under big green leaves. They all wait patiently while the sky takes its noisy bath with big raindrops. Soon the storm will pass and everyone will pop back out to play in the sunshine.

facts.title: Catching the Cool Breeze
facts.text: Before the thunder starts to rumble, do you feel that wonderful chilly wind on your nose? The busy wind comes rushing through the trees to tell everyone a big weather change is coming. It rustles the green leaves and makes your coat hood flap around like a bird's wing. Take a deep breath through your nose and smell the clean, happy air of the storm. The cool breeze is like a giant friendly fan cooling off the whole neighborhood. It helps the heavy clouds float across the sky to water all the thirsty gardens.

facts.title: Puddle Jumping After the Storm
facts.text: Once the loud thunder goes away and the bright lightning finishes its fun sky dance, a new game begins. The clouds sprinkle thousands of shiny raindrops all over the sidewalks and green grass. Now it is time to put on your bright yellow rain boots and step outside. Splash, splash, splash goes your boot right into the biggest, happiest puddle on the block. You can watch tiny ripples bounce across the water like little magic circles. The world is washed clean and shiny, smelling so sweet and fresh just for you.

facts.title: The Sky Giant's Belly Rumble
facts.text: Have you ever heard a big, deep rumble high up in the clouds? It sounds just like a friendly sky giant with a very hungry tummy! When warm air tickles the cold air way up high, they play a game of tag. That tummy rumble is actually sound making a joyful trip through the air to your ears. You do not need to feel scared because it is just the sky stretching its cozy arms. Snuggle up close with your favorite stuffed animal while the big sound rolls by. Soon the noise gets smaller and smaller until it whispers away completely.

facts.title: Quick Flash and the Counting Game
facts.text: Look out your window and watch the sky go blink-blink-blink with super bright light! That quick flash is like a giant camera taking a picture of the sleepy world below. Let us play a fun counting game together while we watch the glittering show. One, two, three, four, five, let us see if we can hear the rumble arrive! The sparkling light always travels super fast through the air before the sound can catch up. It is like a magical game of tag happening way up high in the fluffy clouds. You are a brave little explorer watching nature's most dazzling bedtime show.

facts.title: The Sweet Smell of Muddy Puddles
facts.text: Take a big, deep breath right after the lightning and thunder dance away. Do you smell that wonderful, earthy scent floating all around the neighborhood? The fresh rain tickles the dry dirt and grass to wake up the whole outdoor world. Earthworms wiggle happily and flowers take a long, cool drink from the puddles. Pull on your bright yellow rain boots and step outside to feel the squishy mud. Every little plant and tree smiles because they love a good rain shower just like you do. Nature is taking a refreshing bath and everything smells so clean and wonderful.

facts.title: Snug Safe Inside Our Cozy Den
facts.text: When the thunder starts to boom and lightning flashes, it is time for the coziest indoor adventure. We can build a wonderful blanket fort right in the middle of the warm living room. Crawl inside with your softest pillows and a favorite storybook to read together. Outside, the rain taps a gentle rhythm on the window glass like tiny dancing feet. We are warm and safe inside our snug little den while the weather does its dance. Listen to the storm sing its sleepy song as it wraps the whole house in a hug.

facts.title: The Friendly Sky Brush
facts.text: Did you know that lightning is actually a giant spark of electricity playing in the clouds? It is just like the little static spark you make when rubbing your fuzzy socks on the carpet. The puffy clouds rub together and make tiny little electric zaps of bright white light. It sweeps across the sky like a magical paintbrush coloring the dark clouds for a second. Animals curl up in their cozy dens and watch the pretty show from their windows too. Every little flash reminds us how exciting and wonderful our big wide world truly is.

facts.title: Dancing Shadows on the Bedroom Wall
facts.text: When a nighttime storm visits your neighborhood, bright flashes peek through your window curtains. The lightning skips across the sky like a playful dancer waving a sparkly wand. It paints quick, funny shadows on your bedroom wall that look just like dancing bunnies. You can snuggle deep under your warm blanket and watch the silent light show. There is nothing to fear because your cozy room is safe and sound. Soon, the gentle glowing light dances away into the sleepy night.

facts.title: The Sky Drummer's Loud Parade
facts.text: Sometimes the big puffy clouds decide to play a giant drum set way up high in the sky. Boom, boom, crash goes the noisy drum as the rhythm rolls right over your rooftop. The friendly sky drummer is just making happy music for the plants and trees to hear. You can pretend to be a little drum and tap your fingers softly on the floor. Tap, tap, tap goes your tiny hand while the big thunder rattles outside. It is just nature playing a loud, exciting symphony for everyone to enjoy.

facts.title: Sniffing the Sweet Stormy Air
facts.text: Have you ever stepped outside right after a stormy shower and taken a giant, happy breath? The air smells so fresh and clean like cool peppermint and wet garden dirt mixed together. The lightning and rain help wash the whole world so it looks bright and sparkly again. Little earthworms wiggle happily in the mud while the thirsty flowers drink deeply from puddles. You can stretch your arms wide and smell the wonderful, earthy magic floating all around your toes. Taking a deep breath of the rain-kissed air is such a cozy, refreshing treat.

facts.title: Frogs Singing Their Rainy Day Songs
facts.text: When the sky rumbles with thunder, the happy little green frogs in the pond wake right up. They puff out their little cheeks and sing loud, bubbly songs to celebrate the wet weather. Ribbit, croak, goes the joyful chorus echoing across the splashing water and muddy banks. The frogs love the cool raindrops tickling their slippery backs while the lightning flashes above. They dance on top of floating lily pads and splash their webbed feet with glee. Listening to the singing frogs is like having your very own concert in nature.

facts.title: Building a Safe Pillow Fort Castle
facts.text: When you hear the big thunder grumble outside, it is the absolute best time to build a fortress. You can gather all your softest pillows and fluffy blankets to make a secret indoor castle. Crawl inside your cozy cave with your favorite stuffed teddy bear and a picture book. While the bright lightning flashes outside, you are snug and warm in your special hideaway. Listen closely to the rumbling sounds like a sleepy giant snoring far away. Your little fort is the safest, warmest place in the whole wide world during a storm.

facts.title: The Big Sky Playground Slide
facts.text: Have you ever wondered why lightning flashes across the sky? High up in the fluffy white clouds, tiny water drops and ice crystals play a giant game of tag. They zoom and zip all around, bumping into each other like friendly little bumblebees. When they bump and slide together, they make bright, sparkly electricity! This creates a quick, zig-zagging flash that lights up your bedroom window like a magic camera. It is just the sky having a wonderful, glowing playtime before the gentle rain begins to fall.

facts.title: The Sky Giant's Soft Pillow Drop
facts.text: Do you hear that big, rumbling noise after the bright flash? That is just the friendly sky giant dropping his heaviest, softest pillows onto the clouds! When lightning zips through the air, it gets very hot and makes the air wiggle and giggle. This wiggling air bumps into other air and creates a deep, rolling sound called thunder. It sounds scary, but it is really just a sleepy giant snoring softly up in the clouds. You can snuggle close with your favorite stuffed animal and pretend the sky is tucking everyone in for a nap.

facts.title: The Happy Flower Drink Party
facts.text: Before the lightning and thunder arrive, have you noticed how the little breeze stops and the air feels warm and heavy? All the thirsty garden flowers and tall green trees are waiting quietly for their favorite party. When the rumbling clouds finally open up, cool raindrops splash down like a refreshing drink of water. The roses, daisies, and little blades of grass giggle and slurp up every single drop. They grow taller and brighter, wearing sparkling water hats to celebrate the wonderful storm.

facts.title: Cozy Inside Our Blanket Castle
facts.text: When a big thunderstorm rolls across the neighborhood, it is the best time to stay cozy inside your house. You can build a wonderful castle out of fluffy sofa pillows and warm, colorful blankets. While the lightning flashes outside your window and the thunder rolls like drums, you are safe and warm in your special den. Read your favorite picture book with a tiny flashlight or listen to the raindrops tapping gently on the roof. It is a snuggly adventure where you are the king or queen of your very own indoor fort.

facts.title: The Sparkling Fresh Air Cleaner
facts.text: Have you ever smelled the wonderful air right after a thunderstorm passes by? Outside smells so clean, sweet, and brand new, almost like magic mint leaves! The lightning and falling raindrops help scrub the sky clean of dust and tiny sleepy bugs. When you open your front door after the storm, you can take a big, deep breath of the cool, sparkling air. The world looks washed in bright green and shiny blue, ready for you to put on your yellow boots and go puddle jumping.

facts.title: The Cool Breeze Messenger
facts.text: Before the loud thunder booms and the bright lightning flashes, a very special cool breeze comes to visit. It sweeps gently across your face and whispers that a big rain cloud is floating overhead. This chilly wind feels so refreshing on a warm afternoon. It makes the tall green leaves dance and flutter in the garden. Can you feel the cool air tickling your nose right now? It is nature's gentle way of saying hello before the exciting storm begins.

facts.title: Happy Flowers Drinking Big Sips
facts.text: When lightning flashes and thunder rolls, heavy rain clouds open up to water the thirsty ground. All the pretty red roses, yellow daisies, and green grass patches cheer with joy. They stretch out their leafy arms to catch the delicious, sparkling water drops. The flowers drink deeply and grow bigger and stronger every single time it rains. Outside your window, plants are having a giant party because they love this special weather so much.

facts.title: Jumping in Yellow Rain Boots
facts.text: Stormy weather brings the most fun puddles sparkling on the sidewalk just for you. Putting on your bright yellow rain boots helps you get ready for outdoor adventures. You can stomp and splash in the cool water to make big, exciting water splatters. Splishing and splashing makes the puddles giggle with bubbly white bubbles. It is such a silly and joyful way to play outside while the rain gently taps all around you.

facts.title: Snuggling Safe Under the Warm Quilt
facts.text: When the sky rumbles with loud thunder sounds, it is the coziest time to cuddle up tight. You can wrap yourself in a soft, fuzzy blanket with your favorite stuffed animal friend. Listening to the raindrops drumming on the window sounds like a soothing lullaby. Inside your warm home, you are completely safe, cozy, and loved. It is wonderful to watch the sparkling flashes through the window while resting in your comfy nest.

facts.title: Cleaning the Air for a Brand New Day
facts.text: Did you know that thunderstorms act like giant bath time for the whole wide world? The rushing rain washes away dust from the sleepy tree branches and rooftop tiles. After the thunder stops and the lightning goes away, the air smells so clean and fresh. You can take a deep, happy breath of the sparkling outdoor air. Everything looks bright, renewed, and ready for you to go outside and play once again.

facts.title: The Friendly Flash of Bright Light
facts.text: Have you ever seen a giant camera flash in the cloudy sky? That is bright lightning saying hello from high up in the clouds. It looks like a wiggly silver ribbon dancing across the sky. The warm sunbeams and chilly air play together to make this sparkly light show. When it flashes, we can see all the big puffy clouds glowing like magic lanterns. It is very fast, just like a quick wink from a friendly star.

facts.title: Boom Goes the Sky Drum
facts.text: Do you hear that big rumbling sound rolling through the sky? That is the giant sky drummer playing a very loud song. The sound goes rumble, rumble, rumble, right over our cozy rooftop. It might sound big and strong, but it is just the air making a happy booming noise. We can hold our stuffed animals tight and listen to the music. Soon the big drum song stops, and everything is quiet and peaceful again.

facts.title: Sniffing the Fresh Rain Scents
facts.text: Take a big, deep breath right after the lightning and thunder pass by. Can you smell that wonderful, clean scent outside your window? The sky water washes the whole world and makes the green grass super happy. Flowers and trees drink up the yummy rain and give us sweet smells to breathe in. The air feels cool and tickles our little noses in the best way possible. It is nature's own way of taking a nice, refreshing bath.

facts.title: Hiding in Our Cozy Pillow Fort
facts.text: When the sky drum plays loudly outside, we can build a super special place inside. Let us gather all our softest pillows and biggest blankets right now. We can crawl inside our secret fort with a favorite bedtime storybook. The twinkling fairy lights make our little cave feel so warm and safe. Listening to the stormy weather outside makes staying inside feel like a magical adventure. We are snug as bugs in a rug while the weather dances outside.

facts.title: Waking Up the Thirsty Garden
facts.text: Did you know the thunder and lightning help all the little plants grow big and tall? The bright flashes and rumbling sounds tell the rain clouds to share their water. Little green frogs hop around outside and sing happy songs in the puddles. Flowers open up their colorful petals to catch every single delicious drop of water. The whole garden gets a big drink and smiles up at the bright sky. Everything in nature feels so fresh and ready to play.

facts.title: The Magic Sky Sparkler
facts.text: Look way up high into the big fluffy clouds when a stormy day arrives. Suddenly, a bright squiggle of light dances across the sky like a magical glowing paintbrush. It is just tiny sparkles of electricity playing tag way up in the clouds. This wonderful flash lights up your bedroom window for one quick second. Then it hides away again behind the soft grey blankets of the sky. Isn't it wonderful to watch the sky put on such a sparkly light show just for you?

facts.title: The Sleepy Giant's Rolling Drum
facts.text: Have you ever heard a big rumbling sound roll across the sky right after a bright flash? Some people say it sounds just like a sleepy giant rolling a giant wooden drum. The sound travels slowly through the air, making a deep rumble that shakes the windowpanes just a tiny bit. It is actually just the warm air and cool air saying hello to each other with a loud voice. You can wrap yourself up in a cozy blanket and listen to the giant's sleepy music.

facts.title: Sniffing the Sweet Sweet-Rain Air
facts.text: Take a big, deep breath of air right after a thunderstorm passes by your house. The whole world smells so clean, cool, and wonderfully fresh just for you. The raindrops wash all the sleepy tree leaves and tickle the happy little garden flowers. Tiny invisible helpers in the dirt wake up and make the earth smell sweet and rich. It is nature's very own special perfume floating all around your backyard. Let's close our eyes and take one more giant sniff of that lovely rainy-day magic.

facts.title: Frogs Throwing a Splash Party
facts.text: Listen closely outside when the heavy rain starts to fall from the big grey clouds. Down in the muddy garden pond, the little green frogs are waking up with a smile. They love when the sky gets wet because it is time for a giant pool party. They jump and splash in the puddles, saying ribbit-ribbit to their tiny fish friends. The splashing water makes happy little ripples that dance across the surface of the pond. Every little creature in nature knows that rainy days are meant for having lots of splashing fun.

facts.title: Cozy Bear Cave Inside Our House
facts.text: When the thunder rolls and the lightning flashes outside, we get to build the coziest fort ever. We gather all our softest pillows and biggest blankets right in the middle of the living room floor. It feels so safe and warm inside our special bear cave while the storm passes by. We can read our favorite bedtime stories using a tiny glowing flashlight together. Being snug inside your home makes stormy weather feel like a wonderful indoor camping adventure.

facts.title: Tiny Clouds Dancing Together
facts.text: Have you ever watched fluffy white clouds float gently across the bright blue sky like soft pillows? Sometimes, many playful little clouds bump into each other high up in the air. When they tickle and cuddle together, they get so excited and warm! This friendly cloud hug creates a wonderful big spark that we call lightning. It is just nature's way of playing a fun game of tag in the wonderful sky playground. We can watch the pretty glowing light dance from our cozy window while staying warm and safe inside.

facts.title: The Sky Giant's Soft Footsteps
facts.text: Listen very closely when the big dark clouds roll overhead on a stormy afternoon. Do you hear that deep, rumbly sound rolling across the hills? That is just the sleepy sky giant walking softly with heavy boots. His happy footsteps make the whole world vibrate in a cozy, rumbling way. It is not scary at all, just a sleepy giant saying hello to the sleepy flowers below. We can pretend to stomp our own little feet on the soft carpet to match the gentle music of the rain.

facts.title: Taking a Cool Breath Outside
facts.text: Before a big thunderstorm arrives, do you feel a sudden chilly breeze tickling your nose? That is the clever wind coming around to tell everyone that a refreshing rain is on its way. It sweeps through the tall green trees and whispers secrets to the rustling leaves. This cool breeze helps the whole outdoor world take a nice, deep breath on a hot summer day. We can close our eyes, sniff the wonderful fresh air, and feel the gentle air dancing all around our happy smiling faces.

facts.title: Singing Along with the Raindrops
facts.text: When lightning flashes and thunder rolls, the happy little frogs in the pond throw a grand party. They puff out their green throats and sing loud, joyful songs to celebrate the water. The thirsty green garden plants drink up the sweet raindrops falling from the sky. Every single flower petals opens wide to wash away the dusty day and sparkle in the dim light. We can listen to this lovely symphony of nature playing its favorite rhythm right outside our windowpane.

facts.title: Building Our Indoor Fort of Safety
facts.text: When the great big thunder rumbles loudly outside, it is the best excuse to build a wonderful fort. We can gather all our softest pillows, warm fuzzy blankets, and favorite stuffed animal friends together. Crawling inside our secret twinkling cave makes us feel as cozy as little mice in a hollow tree. We can snuggle up tight and read a favorite bedtime story while the storm passes by. Being safe and warm indoors makes watching the bright weather feel like a magical indoor camping adventure.

facts.title: The Invisible Hug
facts.text: Have you ever felt a gentle kiss on your cheek when you are playing outside in the big, wide yard? That is the friendly wind saying hello to you with a soft, cozy touch. You cannot see the wind with your sleepy eyes because it is completely invisible like magic. But you can feel it tickle your nose and wrap around you like a big, warm hug. It sweeps down from the tall sky just to play tag with your fingers and toes. Close your eyes, breathe in deeply, and feel the happy breeze dance all around you.

facts.title: Dancing Leaves and Flying Kites
facts.text: Look up high into the bright blue sky and watch what the playful wind loves to do all day. It grabs colorful paper kites and pulls them up dancing through the fluffy clouds. Down on the ground, it whispers to the autumn leaves, telling them it is time to leap and twirl. The crunchy brown leaves let go of their tree branches and spin in circles like tiny ballerinas. Trees wave their long green arms back and forth as the breezy music plays on. Everything outside loves to move and groove when the breezy wind comes out to play.

facts.title: The Sunbeam Push
facts.text: Do you wonder what makes the wind start moving across the big green grass and quiet hills? It all begins when warm sunbeams tickle the air and make it nice and cozy. The warm air gets excited and floats upward toward the fluffy white clouds in the sky. Then, cool air rushes in quickly to take its empty place down near your feet. This running around of warm and cool air creates a lovely breeze that cools your forehead. The shining sun and the gentle wind work together to make our wonderful weather every single day.

facts.title: Chasing the Fresh Smells
facts.text: The busy wind is a wonderful traveler that loves to zoom across the whole wide world very fast. As it runs past sweet pink roses and purple lavender, it borrows their lovely springtime smells. Then it carries those happy flower scents right to your nose when you are swinging on the swings. It sweeps over the big blue ocean and brings you the salty, sparkling smell of the sea. Sometimes it brings the earthy smell of fresh rain dancing down on the dry sidewalk. Wherever the breeze travels, it always collects magical smells to share with curious little explorers like you.

facts.title: Dressed for the Windy Parade
facts.text: When the chilly wind decides to blow strong and tall, we get to wear our favorite cozy clothes outside. We zip up our snuggly jackets and pop on silly hats that cover our chilly ears. If we wear a long colorful scarf, the friendly wind will lift it up like a flying superhero cape. We can march around the yard together in a grand parade while the wind drums on our coats. Being outside in the breezy weather is always such a fun and exciting adventure for everyone.

facts.title: The Whispering Trees
facts.text: Have you ever heard the big green trees talking to each other outside your window? When the gentle breeze blows through the branches, the leaves rustle and make a soft shushing sound. It is almost like the forest is sharing a quiet bedtime secret with the world. If you close your eyes and listen very closely, you can hear the wind singing a sleepy lullaby. The tall oak tree sways back and forth, dancing happily as the cool air tickles its wooden toes. Every swish and swoosh tells a little story about where the breeze has traveled today.

facts.title: Cloud Ships Sailing By
facts.text: Look way up high into the bright blue sky at the fluffy white clouds floating lazily along. Do you know what makes those puffy cloud ships move across the sky? It is the friendly wind acting like an invisible captain pushing them gently forward. Sometimes the wind puffs its cheeks and blows a fast little gust to race the clouds across the heaven. You can lie down on the soft green grass and watch the giant marshmallow shapes change into animals and boats. The breezy sky is like a magical moving picture show just for you.

facts.title: The Dandelion Seed Parachutes
facts.text: Have you ever found a round white puffball of a dandelion hiding in the garden grass? If you take a big deep breath and blow gently, something truly magical happens right before your eyes. Tiny white parachutes fly up into the air carrying sleepy baby seeds to new homes. The breezy wind catches every little fairy umbrella and gives it a fun ride across the yard. They spin and twirl like tiny ballerinas dancing in the sunlight before landing softly on the ground. Soon, brand new yellow flowers will grow where the wind dropped them.

facts.title: Busy Little Feathered Flyers
facts.text: Watch the happy little birds outside as they flutter their wings and play games with the breezy weather. Sometimes the wind is so strong that the sparrows have to hold on tight with their tiny feet. Other times, they open their wings wide and let the breeze carry them smoothly without even flapping. It looks like they are sliding down a giant invisible playground slide high up in the sky. They chirp happy little songs to celebrate how much fun it is to fly on a breezy day. Nature is full of wonderful surprises when the wind comes to visit.

facts.title: The Wind Chime Melody
facts.text: Listen to the sweet ringing music coming from the shiny metal tubes hanging on the front porch. When the playful breeze wanders by, it bumps gently against the chimes to make a lovely song. Clink, clonk, ding, dong, the little bells sing out whenever the cool air gives them a poke.
