facts.text: Our beautiful home planet Earth has a wonderful blanket of air all around it. The fluffy white clouds float way up high inside this cozy air blanket. They travel high above tall trees and even higher than flying birds. They are like quiet travelers exploring the big sky world.

facts.title: Shape-Shifting Wonders
facts.text: Watch a fluffy white cloud for a little while. Look closely at its puffy edges. Watch how it changes shape and turns into a funny dinosaur or a sailing boat. The wind gently pushes and pulls the water drops, making wonderful new pictures in the sky just for you.

facts.title: Blankets for the Sun
facts.text: Sometimes a whole bunch of fluffy white clouds cuddle up together and make a giant cloud blanket. When they float right in front of the warm daytime sun, it feels like playing a giant game of peekaboo! The sunshine peeks through their soft edges, sending warm, happy tickles down to your toes.

facts.title: Pillows of the Sky
facts.text: Have you ever looked way up high at the bright blue sky and seen big, soft things floating along? They look just like giant, fluffy pillows made of cotton candy. If you could reach up, you might want to squeeze them gently to see if they feel squishy. Even though they look super soft and cozy, they are actually made of tiny water drops hugging the air. They drift slowly across the world like sleepy giants taking a peaceful nap. Isn't it wonderful to imagine resting your sleepy head on a cloud right now?

facts.title: Dancing with the Wind
facts.text: Watch closely as the bright white puffs move across the big, beautiful sky on a sunny afternoon. Can you see them traveling along without any wheels or little engine sounds? That is because the friendly wind is gently pushing them on a magical journey. The wind blows softly behind them like a giant invisible fan playing a game of tag. Sometimes they race very fast, and other times they stroll along like they have nowhere to be. Wave hello to the traveling clouds as they dance past your window today.

facts.title: Sunlight Hugs
facts.text: When you look up at the daytime sky, notice how the warm yellow sun shines right on the puffy white shapes. The sun gives them a big, bright hug that makes them glow like giant glowing marshmallows. Sometimes a cloud floats right in front of the sun to play a fun game of peekaboo with us. When that happens, the sunshine takes a tiny break, and it gets a little bit cooler outside. Then the cloud moves away, and the happy sunshine tickles your nose once again with its golden light.

facts.title: Raindrop Makers
facts.text: Did you know that those floating white pillows are actually busy little helpers for our whole world? As they travel far across the sky, they collect more and more tiny water drops inside their fluffy bellies. Soon, they grow very big, very heavy, and turn a lovely shade of soft grey. When they are completely full, they let all the sparkling raindrops fall down to give a cool drink to thirsty flowers. Thank you, helpful clouds, for bringing the splashy rain that makes our green grass grow so tall!

facts.title: Sunset Artist
facts.text: When the playful day begins to say goodbye, the sky puts on a colorful show just for you. The bright sun starts to sink down low, painting the sky with pink, purple, and sleepy orange colors. At the exact same time, the fluffy white clouds catch all those pretty colors on their soft edges. They look like glowing cotton candy dipped in sweet strawberry syrup right before bedtime. It is nature saying goodnight to the world and wrapping everything up in a warm, cozy blanket of twilight dreams.

facts.title: Cloud Castles in Space
facts.text: Did you know that fluffy white clouds float way up high in our wonderful sky? They live in the big, beautiful blanket of air that hugs our home planet Earth. When you look up through your sleepy little eyes, those soft white puffs look just like giant floating castles. They dance happily among the twinkling stars and the bright yellow daytime sun. Sometimes a brave rocket ship zooms right past them on its way to visit the moon. Aren't our sky castles just the most magical, cozy places to imagine playing in today?

facts.title: Painting the Blue Sky
facts.text: Have you ever wondered why the sky is such a pretty blue behind all those fluffy white clouds? Our wonderful Earth is surrounded by a special invisible bubble filled with air and sparkly sunlight. When the warm sunshine says hello to our planet every single morning, it paints the big sky a lovely bright blue. Then, the fluffy white clouds float across that pretty blue canvas like friendly little artists. They wave hello to the birds and smile down at all the happy children playing outside. What a wonderful picture our sky makes just for you.

facts.title: A Gentle Ride with the Breeze
facts.text: Listen very closely and you might hear the soft wind whispering through the tall green trees today. The wind is a gentle friend who loves to gently push those fluffy white clouds across the sky. They do not have little legs to walk, so the friendly breeze gives them a wonderful ride. They drift slowly along like sleepy white sailboats on a big blue ocean of air. You can watch them glide past the warm daytime sun and wave goodbye as they travel far away. Isn't it wonderful how nature helps everyone move around together in our big world?

facts.title: Tickly White Cotton
facts.text: If you could stretch your arms up super high and touch a fluffy white cloud, what would it feel like? It might feel just like a giant handful of tickly soft cotton candy or a warm pillow. Even though they look solid enough to sit on, they are actually made of tiny floating water drops and cool air. When the gentle breeze blows them close together, they look like cozy sheep grazing in a blue meadow. They love to play hide and seek with the bright daytime sun all afternoon long. Would you like to catch a fluffy cloud right in your little hand?

facts.title: Singing Lullabies to the Sun
facts.text: When the day is all finished and it is almost time for your sleepy bedtime stories, something magical happens. The fluffy white clouds change their bright daytime coats for sparkly coats of pink and golden orange. They gather together around the warm setting sun to sing a gentle bedtime lullaby for our whole planet. They tuck the sun in tight behind the edge of the world so the glowing night sky can come out. Then the twinkling stars and the pretty moon wake up to watch over you. Sweet dreams to the clouds and sweet dreams to you, little star.

facts.title: Stardust Helpers
facts.text: Look up at the bright blue sky on a sunny afternoon and wave hello to the fluffy white clouds! Did you know these soft clouds act like friendly helpers for our planet Earth? They float way up high near the stars and the moon, catching warm sunshine in their cozy white hugs. When our big home planet feels a little bit too warm from the daytime sun, the clouds gently block the bright rays. They spread cool, gentle shadows across green grass, tall trees, and happy children playing outside. It is just like having a giant, floating parasol made of sweet cotton candy right up in the sky. Every single cloud works hard to keep our special world safe, cool, and peaceful all day long.

facts.title: Spaceship Cloud Jumpers
facts.text: Imagine zooming past the twinkling stars in a shiny silver rocket ship with brave astronauts wearing giant white spacesuits! As your speedy rocket zooms higher and higher into zero-gravity, you get to zoom right past the fluffy white clouds. From far out in space, our beautiful blue and green home planet Earth looks like a swirling marble wrapped in ribbons of white. The clouds look like giant, bouncy trampolines floating peacefully in the dark, starry ocean of space. Astronauts love to look out their round windows and watch the soft clouds drift slowly by without making a single sound. It is a magical journey through the cosmos where clouds become your soft neighbors floating among the shining constellations.

facts.title: Moonlight Sleeping Bags
facts.text: When the warm daytime sun goes to sleep and the glowing night sky wakes up, what happens to the fluffy white clouds? They do not go away at all, little explorer! Instead, they put on their nighttime pajamas and turn into soft, glowing sleeping bags for the silver moon and twinkling stars. As the shape of the moon changes each night from a banana smile to a big round circle, the clouds tuck it in tightly. The moonlight bounces off the white edges of the clouds, making them sparkle like silver fairy dust in the dark. If you look closely before bedtime, you might see the moon peeking out from behind a fluffy cloud blanket, smiling down and whispering sweet dreamland lullabies to you.

facts.title: Whispering Sky Giants
facts.text: Did you know that fluffy white clouds are actually giant, friendly storytellers living way up high in the open blue sky? When the wind blows gently, these soft white giants change their costumes and tell wonderful visual stories just for you. One minute a cloud looks like a playful puppy chasing a ball, and the next minute it turns into a swimming whale. They float silently past the shining stars and the glowing moon, practicing their slow-motion ballet moves high above the rooftops. Whenever you feel like resting, you can lay down on the soft green grass and watch the whispering sky giants perform their endless magic shows. It is a quiet, wonderful reminder of how big, beautiful, and imaginative our wonderful world truly is.

facts.title: Sunbeam Painters
facts.text: Every morning when the golden sun wakes up to paint our beautiful blue and green home planet Earth, it needs a very special helper. That helper is the fluffy white cloud floating peacefully in the morning sky! The bright sunbeams reach out and hug the white clouds, turning their fluffy edges into glowing gold and bright pink ribbons. Together, the sun and the clouds paint a breathtaking masterpiece right above our heads for everyone to admire. It feels like waking up inside a giant watercolor painting where the colors dance and swirl in the gentle morning breeze. These morning clouds show us that even the simplest things in nature can team up to make our whole world look like pure, glowing magic.

facts.title: Peekaboo Behind the Blue
facts.text: Look way up high into the big blue sky today. Have you ever wondered where fluffy white clouds come from to visit us? Tiny, invisible water drops drink the warm sunshine and float up high. They hold hands together to make big, bouncy white shapes. Sometimes they play an exciting game of peekaboo with our golden sun. They gently cover the sunshine for a moment and then slide away. Every time you look up, you can wave hello to your floating friends.

facts.title: Floating Sky Blankets
facts.text: Imagine the biggest, softest bed floating right above your head in the bright sky. Fluffy white clouds look just like cozy white blankets made of cotton candy. Even though they look heavy like giant pillows, they are actually made of tiny water drops. If you could reach all the way up, they would feel cool and wet like morning fog. They drift lazily across the sky like sleepy giants taking a nice long nap. Close your eyes and pretend you are resting on a fluffy white cloud right now.

facts.title: Shape-Shifting Wonders
facts.text: Step outside into the fresh air and look at the changing pictures in the sky. Fluffy white clouds love to change their shapes while they dance through the air. One minute a cloud looks just like a bouncy bunny rabbit hopping past. The next minute, the wind tickles it into a roaring lion with a big mane. Use your wonderful imagination to find all sorts of secret animals hiding in the white puffs. The friendly sky is always painting brand new stories for you to watch every single day.

facts.title: Sunbeam Gold and Silver Linings
facts.text: Watch closely as the bright daytime sun plays tag with the fluffy white clouds. When the warm sunshine peeks around the edges of a big white cloud, something magical happens. The fuzzy borders glow with bright silver and sparkly golden light just for you. It looks like the cloud is wearing a shiny crown made of pure sunshine. The sun and the clouds work together as best friends to light up our wonderful world. Isn't it amazing how water and sunlight can make such beautiful glowing art in the sky?

facts.title: Gentle Travelers of the Wind
facts.text: Have you ever wondered why fluffy white clouds never stay in the exact same spot? The invisible wind is a gentle giant that loves to push the clouds along. The wind gives every single cloud a friendly ride across the wide blue sky. They travel on a grand journey visiting different towns, tall mountains, and green trees. Sometimes they move super fast when the wind tickles them, and sometimes they float very slow. Wave goodbye as your fluffy white cloud friends sail far away on their windy adventure.

facts.title: Tiny Water Drops Holding Hands
facts.text: Look way up high at the fluffy white clouds in the bright blue sky. Did you know those soft clouds are actually made of tiny, tiny drops of water? These little drops are so small and light that they float in the air. When millions of them hold hands together, they make a big puffy cloud. You can pretend you are floating right up there with them on a warm sunny day. Isn't it amazing how water can make such wonderful shapes in the sky?

facts.title: Sunbeam Gold and Silver Hugs
facts.text: When you look at a fluffy white cloud, have you ever noticed its bright glowing edges? That is the warm daytime sun giving the cloud a big golden hug. The sunbeams wrap all around the little water drops inside the cloud. This makes the edges shine like sparkling silver and warm gold. If you watch closely, the sun and the clouds play a fun game of hide and seek together. It is like a magical painting made just for you in the sky.

facts.title: Chasing the Breezy Wind
facts.text: Have you ever watched a puffy white cloud slowly moving across the sky without any wheels? That is because the friendly wind is giving the cloud a gentle ride. The breeze blows softly and pushes the fluffy cloud across the blue sky. You can stand outside in the yard and pretend you are blowing the clouds along too. Watch them sail past the tall trees and over the houses. Where do you think those happy traveling clouds are going today?

facts.title: Soft Pillows for the Sky
facts.text: Sometimes the big white clouds look just like giant, cozy pillows floating way up high. If you could reach up and touch one, it would probably feel as soft as your favorite bedtime blanket. They look so gentle and peaceful resting in the wide blue sky. You can lay down on the soft grass and imagine resting your head on a fluffy cloud. It is a wonderful way to relax and watch the quiet world go by.

facts.title: Magic Shape-Shifting Friends
facts.text: Look up at that big puffy cloud right now and tell me what you see. Does it look like a friendly puppy dog, a fluffy bunny, or a sailing ship? Clouds love to change their shapes as they float through the sunny sky. One minute a cloud looks like a fluffy bear, and the next minute it turns into a gentle crown. Your imagination can help you discover all sorts of secret surprises hidden in the clouds. What fun new shape will you find next?

facts.title: Tiny Tiny Raindrop Pearls
facts.text: Did you know our friendly fluffy white clouds are actually made of millions of tiny tiny water drops? They are so small and light that they float way up high in the sky. When you look up on a bright sunny day, you are seeing a gentle river of floating water pearls. These little drops hold hands tightly together to make big puffy shapes. If you could reach up and touch them, they would feel like a cool, wet misty hug. Isn't it amazing that the sky is full of tiny floating water friends?

facts.title: Breezy Sky Train Rides
facts.text: Have you ever watched a big fluffy cloud slowly drift across the bright blue sky? The breezy wind acts like a gentle train conductor pushing them along on a fun journey. They float past tall trees and peek over high rooftop tops without making a single sound. Sometimes they zoom very fast when the wind blows hard, and other times they take a nice slow nap. You can sit on the soft grass and wave goodbye as your puffy white friends travel far away. Where do you think they are going on their big sky adventure today?

facts.title: Sunbeam Gold and Silver Sparkles
facts.text: When the warm daytime sun shines brightly on our fluffy white clouds, something magical happens in the sky. The golden sunshine wraps all around the puffy edges and makes them glow like shiny silver jewels. Sometimes the middle stays bright white while the bottom gets a cozy grey shadow hug. It looks as though a giant painter brushed sparkly glitter right across the daytime air. If you close your eyes and imagine it, you can almost see the sun playing tag with the clouds. Every single day brings a brand new glowing picture just for you.

facts.title: Magic Shape Shifting Friends
facts.text: Look up high right now and tell me what funny shapes you can see floating by. That puffy white cloud over there looks just like a friendly jumping bunny rabbit with long ears. Wait, now the gentle breeze is tickling it and turning it into a roaring puppy dog! Clouds love to play dress up and change their costumes all day long just to make you smile. You can use your wonderful imagination to find all sorts of sleeping cats and cruising boats. What wonderful shape will your fluffy sky friend turn into next?

facts.title: Soft Pillows for the Birds
facts.text: When tired little birds fly way up high near the bright blue sky, they see the fluffy white clouds all around. They look just like enormous, cozy pillows made out of soft cotton candy feathers. Even though we cannot bounce on them like our beds at home, they make the sky look very friendly. The brave little birds flutter right past them on their way to tall green trees. It is comforting to know that our big beautiful world has such soft and gentle things floating above us.

facts.title: Painting the Blue Sky White
facts.text: Look way up high into the big bright blue sky today! Do you see those wonderful, fluffy white shapes floating up there like giant balls of cotton? They look just like soft, cozy pillows resting gently in the air. The warm yellow sun shines bright and happy all around them. When the golden sunlight hugs these sleepy clouds, they glow like bright white sugar candy. They are not heavy at all, and they float higher than the tall trees and birds. Let us wave hello to our puffy white friends up in the sky!

facts.title: Hiding and Seeking with the Sun
facts.text: Sometimes the fluffy white clouds love to play a fun game of hide-and-seek with the warm sun! The bright sun peeks out to tickle your nose with warm, happy rays. Then, a big puffy cloud gently drifts right in front of the sun. Suddenly, it feels a little bit cooler and shadier in our cozy backyard garden. When the cloud floats away again, *pop*, the warm sunshine comes right back to say hello! It is the biggest, happiest game in the whole wide sky. Can you pretend to hide your face and then peek out just like the sun?

facts.title: Catching a Ride on Breezy Winds
facts.text: Have you ever wondered how those fluffy white clouds move across the sky without any little wheels? The invisible wind is a gentle giant that loves to blow soft kisses at them. The friendly breeze pushes the white clouds along on a wonderful, slow-motion sky journey. They sail past the tall mountains and drift quietly over the sparkling blue ocean. You can pretend to be a fluffy cloud blowing in the breeze right now. Take a deep, gentle breath, and blow softly like the wind to move your imaginary cloud across the room!

facts.title: Millions of Tiny Water Drops
facts.text: If we could fly up in a magical rocket ship to touch those fluffy white clouds, what do you think we would find? They are actually made of millions and millions of tiny, cool water drops holding hands! They are so light and friendly that they float together in big cozy groups. When you drink a cool glass of water on a hot day, remember those tiny drops up in the sky. They are having a big pool party way up high in the bright blue air. Let us wiggle our fingers just like those tiny, dancing water drops!

facts.title: Cozy Blankets When the Sun Sleeps
facts.text: When the daytime sun gets sleepy and says goodnight, the sky changes into a dark, starry night blanket. But where do the fluffy white clouds go when it is time for bed? Some clouds catch the last pink and orange rays of the sunset and turn into sleepy pastel blankets. They tuck the sleeping world in tight under the dark, twinkling night sky. The glowing silver moon shines down softly right through their soft, gentle edges. Close your eyes for a second and imagine drifting off to sleep on a fluffy night cloud.

facts.title: Floating High Above Our Blue Earth
facts.text: When you look up at our beautiful blue and green home planet Earth from way out in space, you can see puffy white clouds floating all around. They look like soft cotton candy wrapping around our world like a cozy hug. These gentle clouds sail high above the tall trees, the deep blue oceans, and the big green mountains. They are travelers of the sky, journeying around our spinning home every single day. Even when you are playing down in your backyard, these wonderful sky blankets are watching over you with love. Isn't it amazing to think our whole planet is wrapped in such soft, friendly magic?

facts.title: A Cozy Snuggle with the Warm Sun
facts.text: Up in the bright daytime sky, fluffy white clouds love to play a sweet game with the warm golden sun. Sometimes a big friendly cloud steps right in front of the sunshine to give the earth a cool, shady hug. Then, the warm sunbeams peek out from the sides, painting the sky with sparkling gold and bright silver smiles. Together, the glowing sun and the soft white clouds make the daytime feel so bright and happy. You can look up and watch them dance together in the big blue sky. It is like the sun and the clouds are best friends sharing a joyful playtime.

facts.title: Rockets Zooming Past Sky Pillows
facts.text: Brave astronauts wearing giant, puffy spacesuits climb inside huge rockets that zoom right past the fluffy white clouds. Whoosh! The mighty rocket goes higher and higher, leaving the soft cloud pillows far below as it travels into the dark, sparkly space. The astronauts wave goodbye to the fluffy clouds as they fly up to visit the glowing moon and the twinkling stars. They float in zero-gravity where they can do slow-motion flips in the air. When they look out the window, those friendly white clouds remind them of home, waiting safely on our blue and green planet.

facts.title: Catching Moonlight and Starry Sparkles
facts.text: When the warm daytime sun goes to sleep and the glowing night sky takes over, the fluffy white clouds change their coats of color. They turn into sleepy silver pillows that catch the soft, magical light of the silvery moon. Tiny twinkling stars peek out from behind the edges of the clouds like little diamond eyes winking at you. The clouds gently rock the night sky to sleep, wrapping the moon and stars in a soft, dreamy embrace. It is such a peaceful bedtime story happening right outside your bedroom window. Close your eyes and imagine resting on those cozy, moonlit clouds.

facts.title: Magical Shapes in the Constellation Sky
facts.text: Did you know that fluffy white clouds can sometimes look like giant animals playing hide and seek in the sky? On a sunny day, you might see a cloud shaped like a fluffy bunny, a gentle giant bear, or a sailing ship. They change their shapes as the breezy wind tickles them and moves them across the bright blue heavens. It is a wonderful puzzle just for your imagination to solve while you lay on the green grass. The clouds invite you to dream big and see magical creatures floating right above your head. Every time you look up, there is a brand new story waiting to be discovered.

facts.title: Floating High Above Our Green Trees
facts.text: Look way up high into the bright blue daytime sky today. Do you see those wonderful fluffy white clouds floating so gently? They look like giant cotton candy puffs dancing in the air. These soft white shapes are actually sailing way above our tallest trees. They wave hello to the birds and the warm sunshine as they pass by. Isn't it wonderful to watch them drift slowly across the world?

facts.title: Glowing Lanterns in the Night Sky
facts.text: When the friendly daytime sun goes to sleep, the dark night sky comes out to play. Did you know those white clouds can catch the silver light of the moon? They turn into glowing night lanterns floating in the dark velvet space. If you look closely, they look like sleepy sheep resting in the starry meadows. The gentle moon tucked behind them says goodnight to all the little children down below.

facts.title: Peeking Stars Through Snowy Blankets
facts.text: Sometimes the fluffy white clouds gather together to make a cozy blanket in the sky. If you peek between the puffy white edges, you can spot tiny twinkling stars hiding behind them. It is like a giant game of peekaboo played by the universe. The stars blink their bright little eyes and smile down at your window. Can you count how many sparkly points you can see through the cloud gaps?

facts.title: Brave Rockets Zooming Past Soft Mist
facts.text: Imagine zooming inside a big roaring rocket ship up toward the twinkling stars. As the spaceship climbs higher and higher, it drives right through the fluffy white clouds. It feels like zooming through a giant room full of soft cotton pillows. The cool cloud mist tickles the shiny metal windows of the brave rocket. Then, ZOOM, the spaceship bursts right out into the starry dark space beyond!

facts.title: Our Beautiful Blue Home Planet View
facts.text: Our wonderful home planet Earth is a giant ball of blue water and green trees floating in space. When brave astronauts look down from their special spaceships, they see our lovely world spinning slowly. They see swirls of fluffy white clouds wrapping our planet like a warm hug. It is the most peaceful and beautiful picture you could ever imagine seeing. Our world is a safe and cozy home for every single one of us.

facts.title: Our Blue and Green Home
facts.text: Look all around you, little explorer, because we live on a giant, beautiful ball called Planet Earth. From far away in the dark, sparkly sky, our home looks like a glowing blue marble with big green patches. The shiny blue parts are sparkling oceans filled with splashing fish and rolling waves. The green parts are grassy fields, tall whispering trees, and bumpy mountains reaching up to the clouds. Earth floats peacefully all by itself in deep space, spinning around and around like a top. It gives us cozy air to breathe, warm sunshine to play in, and a safe place to sleep every single night. Isn't it wonderful to live on such a magical, colorful planet?

facts.title: The Warm Daytime Sun
facts.text: Every morning when you wake up, a big, bright, golden ball of fire pops up in the sky. That is our wonderful Sun, sending warm, cozy hugs all the way down to Planet Earth. It helps tiny seeds grow into tall flowers, sweet juicy strawberries, and leafy green trees. The Sun makes the daytime so bright that we can run, jump, laugh, and play outside with our friends. When you feel that gentle warmth tickling your nose, that is the Sun saying hello to you. It gives us happy days full of light and keeps our whole world nice and warm. When playtime is over, the Sun slowly hides so we can rest.

facts.title: The Glowing Night Sky
facts.text: When the golden Sun goes to sleep, a velvety blanket of deep blue and purple covers the sky. Tiny, twinkling stars blink open like sleepy little eyes high above your cozy little bed. They shine with silvery light, making giant dot-to-dot pictures way up high in the dark expanse. Sometimes you might even spot a fast shooting star zipping quickly across the midnight sky. You can make a quiet wish on it before it disappears behind a fluffy cloud. The night sky is quiet and peaceful, wrapping the whole world in a soft, sleepy hug. It is nature's own quiet bedtime story shining down just for you.

facts.title: The Changing Shapes of the Moon
facts.text: Look up at the night sky and you will often see a glowing silver shape smiling back at you. That is our friendly neighbor, the Moon, floating softly through the dark space around Earth. Sometimes it looks like a round, bright dinner plate glowing in the middle of the night. Other times it sneaks into a curved banana shape, like a big smiling grin in the clouds. The Moon changes its outfit every single night as it travels on its quiet journey. It acts like a giant nightlight for all the sleepy animals resting down below. Isn't it fun to wave goodnight to the friendly Moon before you drift off to sleep?

facts.title: Brave Astronauts and Zooming Rockets
facts.text: Far above the clouds, brave explorers called astronauts wear giant puffy white suits to float in space. They fly in super-fast rockets that roar with a loud whoosh and zoom past the stars. Inside their floating spaceships, they can do silly flips and float right in the air without touching the floor. They look out their round windows and wave hello to our beautiful blue planet floating far away. Someday, when you grow big and strong, you could build your own cardboard rocket ship. You can pretend to blast off past the Moon and explore the wonderful starry universe. The amazing adventures of space are just waiting for your big, beautiful imagination!

facts.title: Twinkling Starlight Above
facts.text: When the sun goes to sleep, tiny glowing lights wake up high in the velvet sky. These magical stars twinkle like sleepy fireflies dancing in the dark. They are giant balls of burning gas shining from very, very far away. If you look closely, you can connect them to make big pictures like dot-to-dots. Sometimes, a super fast shooting star zips by in a flash. Make a little wish and wave hello to the twinkling friends up high.

facts.title: Floating in Giant Spacesuits
facts.text: Brave explorers called astronauts travel in huge rockets far away from our home. Inside their spaceships, everything floats around like magic bubbles in the air. To walk outside in space, astronauts wear super heavy suits with big bubble helmets. These special suits keep them safe and help them breathe fresh air. They get to look right down at our beautiful blue planet from way up high. Someday, maybe you will be a brave space explorer too.

facts.title: The Moon's Peek-a-Boo Shapes
facts.text: Every single night, our shiny friend the Moon plays a big game of peek-a-boo. Sometimes it looks like a round silver ball shining brightly in the dark. Other nights, it changes into a sleepy curved banana shape called a crescent. It never really changes size, but shadows make it look different as it spins. The glowing moon acts as a friendly nightlight for all the animals sleeping below. Look out your window tonight to see what shape our glowing moon is wearing.

facts.title: Our Great Big Ocean Home
facts.text: Our wonderful home planet is called Earth, and it is a giant spinning ball in space. Most of our world is covered in deep, sparkly blue water where whales and dolphins play. Green forests and tall brown mountains give all the animals cozy places to live. Earth floats peacefully all by itself surrounded by shiny stars and glowing planets. It is the only home we have, and it gives us everything we need. Give a big warm hug to our lovely planet Earth today.

facts.title: The Warm Daytime Sun
facts.text: Every morning, a big golden sun wakes up to tickle your toes with warm light. It climbs high into the bright blue sky to help flowers grow and birds sing. The friendly sun gives us cozy warmth and makes daytime wonderful for playing outside. When it feels too hot, we can sit in the cool shade of a leafy tree. As evening comes, the sun gives us a pretty orange sunset before going to sleep.

facts.title: Spinning Around and Around
facts.text: Did you know our big planet Earth is always moving? It spins around like a happy top all day and all night long! When your side of Earth faces the warm sun, it is daytime for us to play outside. When your side turns away from the golden sun, it gets cozy and dark for bedtime. We never feel it spinning because we are moving right along with it! Isn't it amazing how our home world gives us both bright sunny days and sleepy starry nights?

facts.title: Whistling Wind and Weather
facts.text: Earth is wrapped in a giant blanket of soft air called the atmosphere. This cozy invisible blanket keeps us warm and gives us all kinds of wonderful weather to explore! Sometimes the friendly wind blows gently to tickle your cheeks and make colorful kites dance high in the sky. Other times, big fluffy clouds bring cool raindrops to help tall green trees and pretty flowers grow big and strong. Every single day brings a brand new weather adventure right outside your window.

facts.title: Dancing Rivers and High Mountains
facts.text: Our wonderful world is full of amazing places for animals and people to live. Sparkling blue rivers sing happy songs as they wiggle and waggle all the way to the salty ocean. Tall, rocky mountains stretch way up high to tickle the fluffy white clouds in the sky. There are grassy green valleys where fuzzy little sheep love to play hide and seek together. Every corner of our beautiful planet Earth holds a special, magical treasure just waiting to be discovered by curious little explorers like you.

facts.title: A Cozy Spaceship for Everyone
facts.text: Imagine floating high up in the starry black sky and looking back down at our home. Earth looks like a glowing blue and green marble swirling with white clouds! It is the only place in the whole wide universe with cool water to splash in and fresh air to breathe. We share this wonderful floating home with millions of friendly animals, buzzing bugs, and tall trees. Earth is our very own special spaceship, keeping us safe and happy as we travel together through space.

facts.title: Bouncing Up on Other Worlds
facts.text: Have you ever wondered what it would feel like to jump and play somewhere else? On our planet Earth, gravity gives us big hugs and gently pulls our feet right back down to the ground. That means when you jump up high, you safely land right back on the soft green grass! But way out in space, things are wonderfully different because there is no gravity to hold you down. Astronauts can bounce super high like bouncy balls and float around just like happy bubbles in the air.

facts.title: Fluttering Green Forests
facts.text: Look closely at our wonderful planet Earth from the big sky above. You will see huge patches of bright, cheerful green all around us. Those are the tall trees and leafy forests where little squirrels and chatty birds live. The leafy trees breathe out fresh air that helps you take a deep, happy breath. When the gentle wind blows through the branches, it sounds like the trees are whispering a cozy lullaby. We can give a big hug to a rough tree trunk and say thank you for keeping our home so green.

facts.title: Tickly White Clouds
facts.text: Have you ever looked way up high and seen fluffy white shapes drifting across the blue sky? Those are soft clouds made of tiny, gentle water drops floating way up in the air. Sometimes they look just like cuddly sheep or zooming bunny rabbits playing tag. When the clouds get very full and heavy, they give us a refreshing drink of rainwater for the thirsty flowers. Then they peek open to let the warm sunbeams tickle your nose with golden light. It is like a magical sky blanket that keeps us safe and dry.

facts.title: Singing Blue Rivers
facts.text: Listen very closely as you play outside, and you might hear a lovely bubbling sound rushing right by. That is a sparkling blue river winding its way across the grassy ground to the big sea. The cool water splashes playfully over smooth round stones and tickles the little frogs sitting on the banks. Friendly fish swim happily through the current, doing little loops and turns in the stream. Every drop of water on our planet loves to travel on a grand adventure from the mountains to the ocean.

facts.title: Crunchy Brown Mountains
facts.text: Stretch your arms up as high as they can possibly reach to feel how tall our big world is. Down on the ground, there are giant mountains made of solid rock stretching up to touch the clouds. They wear snowy white hats on their very top peaks even when the sun is shining down below. Little mountain goats love to climb up the steep slopes with their sturdy little hooves. From way up high on those rocky peaks, you can look down and see the whole wide world looking so tiny and peaceful.

facts.title: Golden Sandy Beaches
facts.text: Imagine running your bare little toes through warm, soft yellow sand right where the bubbly blue water meets the land. The gentle ocean waves roll up onto the shore with a sweet whoosh and tickle your ankles. You can scoop up the damp sand to build giant castles with tall towers and moats. Tiny little seashells hide in the sand like tiny treasures waiting for your curious fingers to find them. The beach is a wonderful playground where the land and the great big ocean give each other a friendly hug.

facts.title: Glittering City Lights at Night
facts.text: When the cozy sun goes down to sleep, our whole planet turns into a sparkling party of lights. If you look down at Earth from far away up in the starry sky, you can see millions of tiny glowing spots. These bright golden lights come from houses, cars, and streets where families like yours are tucked into bed. It looks like someone dropped a big handful of twinkling diamonds all over the ground. Animals sleep in the dark while the city lights keep watch until morning comes again. Isn't it wonderful that our big home shines so brightly in the dark night?

facts.title: Swirly White Blanket of Air
facts.text: Did you know that Planet Earth wears a giant, invisible cozy blanket all around itself? We call this blanket the air, and we breathe it in and out every single day to stay strong and healthy. If you look way up high, you can sometimes see soft, fluffy white clouds floating inside this blanket. The air keeps our world just warm enough, like a gentle hug from someone who loves you very much. It carries sweet smells of flowers and helps colorful kites dance up in the blue sky. We cannot hold the air in our hands, but we feel it tickling our cheeks when the breeze blows.

facts.title: The Friendly North and South Poles
facts.text: Way up at the very top and very bottom of our round Earth are two magical, snowy places called the poles. These special corners of our planet are covered in thick white snow and sheets of sparkly ice. Adorable black-and-white penguins waddle around the bottom pole while fluffy polar bears nap at the top pole. The weather here is super chilly, and the snow crunches softly under cozy little boots. Sparkling icebergs float gently in the freezing blue water like giant floating castles made of crystal. Our wonderful world holds so many different surprises, from warm sunny beaches to these freezing wonderland places.

facts.title: Humming Green Jungle Gardens
facts.text: Deep in the middle of our great big world are magical places called rainforests where everything is bright green and full of life. Tall, leafy trees reach way up high to tickle the passing clouds with their friendly branches. Colorful birds with feathers of red, yellow, and blue sing happy little songs all day long. Little dart frogs hop around on giant leaves that look just like green umbrellas protecting the ground. The warm rain falls down to give thirsty plants a big drink, and then the sun comes out to warm everything up. It is a noisy, busy, and beautiful garden that helps keep our planet happy.

facts.title: Dancing Northern Lights in the Sky
facts.text: Sometimes high up above the snowy places on Earth, the night sky puts on a magical, glowing light show. Swirling ribbons of bright green, soft purple, and pink dance softly through the dark stars. They wiggle and bend just like colorful scarves blowing gently in the evening wind. People wrap up in warm blankets outside to watch the glowing colors paint the sleepy night. It does not make any sound at all, just a silent, beautiful dance high above our heads. Our special planet knows how to make the most wonderful artwork right in the starry sky.

facts.title: Deep Blue Ocean Hugs
facts.text: Did you know our wonderful Earth looks like a shiny blue marble from way up high in the sky? That is because giant, sparkling oceans cover most of our lovely home planet. Playful little fish wiggle their tails in the warm, salty waves all day long. Gentle whales sing soft, bubbly songs deep down in the cozy blue water. The bright sun warms the surface so we can splash and paddle our toes. Our wonderful blue oceans give us so much magic to explore every single day.

facts.title: Busy Little Ants in the Dirt
facts.text: Down on the ground, our planet Earth is full of busy little secrets to discover. Tiny brown ants march in a straight line carrying bits of green leaves. Friendly earthworms wiggle through the rich, dark soil like squiggly pink noodles. They help the pretty flowers and tall trees grow big and strong. When you crunch through the park, you share the ground with so many tiny neighbors. Every little bug on our planet is a special helper in nature.

facts.title: Humming Sweet Honeybees
facts.text: Buzz, buzz, hear the happy little honeybees flying through the sunny garden air today! They zoom from flower to flower collecting sweet yellow pollen on their tiny fuzzy legs. The bright blossoms open wide to say hello to our buzzing little friends. Without them, our yummy apples and strawberries would not grow big and juicy. They help keep our green planet blooming with bright colors and sweet smells. Let us watch them dance in the sunshine without ever scaring them away.

facts.title: Crunchy Golden Autumn Leaves
facts.text: When the gentle breeze blows cool, our planet Earth changes into lovely red and gold. The tall trees whisper soft stories and drop their crunchy leaves down to the grass. You can stomp your boots through the crackly piles and watch them flutter up high. It feels just like a golden rain made specially for little explorers. Mother Nature tucks the sleepy seeds into bed under the warm blanket of leaves. Everything rests until the springtime sun wakes them all up again.

facts.title: Sparkling White Winter Snow
facts.text: When the air gets chilly, tiny ice crystals fall softly from the gray winter clouds. They make a sparkly white blanket that covers the sleeping houses and quiet trees. Every single snowflake is shaped like a tiny, magical star made just for you. You can catch them on your mittens and watch them melt into happy little puddles. Building a bumpy snowman with a carrot nose is the best fun ever. Our planet loves to dress up in sparkling white for a cozy winter nap.

facts.title: Bouncing Brown Muddy Puddles
facts.text: After a soft and gentle rain shower falls from the big sky, wonderful muddy puddles wait on the ground just for you. Little rain boots love to splash right into the gooey, squishy brown mud with a happy squelch. Earth is a wonderful home because it gives us lovely water to drink and playful dirt to touch. Wiggle your little toes inside your socks and imagine all the wiggly earthworms smiling down below. The warm sun will soon come out to dry the puddles, but we can always make new happy memories playing outside today.

facts.title: Shiny Red Apple Orchards
facts.text: High up on sturdy wooden branches, round red apples grow plump and sweet in the gentle breeze. Friendly green leaves whisper lovely secrets to the birds while the juicy fruit gets bigger every single day. Reach up with your tiny hands to gently pick a crunchy apple straight from the friendly tree. Taking a big juicy bite makes a happy crunch sound that fills the sunny afternoon with pure joy. Our beautiful planet Earth is like a giant magical garden that grows the most delicious snacks for us to eat.

facts.title: Buzzy Yellow Bumblebees
facts.text: Buzz, buzz, buzz goes the fuzzy little bee flying from one bright flower to another in the warm meadow. These busy helpers wear cozy yellow and black stripes as they dance through the sweet-smelling spring air. They collect golden pollen to help our wonderful planet grow even more colorful blossoms and yummy fruits. Listen closely to the gentle buzzing sound and pretend you are a tiny flying insect exploring the grass. Earth is so full of tiny living friends who work together to make our outdoor world bloom beautifully every day.

facts.title: Sleepy Fuzzy Little Bears
facts.text: Deep inside cozy caves and hollow tree trunks, furry brown bears snuggle up for a long and restful winter nap. They close their sleepy eyes and dream sweet dreams while the cold wind whistles softly outside their woodland homes. Little bear cubs cuddle tightly against their mama to stay extra warm and cozy all through the chilly night. When springtime finally arrives with warm sunshine, the sleepy bears will wake up and stretch their paws. Our amazing Earth takes wonderful care of all the animals, giving them safe places to sleep and grow.

facts.title: Silver Sparkling Morning Dewdrops
facts.text: When the sleepy sun first wakes up in the morning, tiny water drops sparkle like little diamonds on the grass. Every single blade of green grass wears a shiny silver crown made of cool morning dew. If you peek very closely, you can see your own tiny smiley face reflected inside the little water bubble. Gently touch the wet grass with your finger and feel how refreshing and cool the morning feels. Planet Earth loves to decorate itself with sparkling morning magic just to make your day start with a smile.

facts.title: Floating Spaceship Earth
facts.text: Look way up past the fluffy clouds into the big, dark night sky. Our special home planet Earth is floating right there like a giant blue marble. It spins round and round in the cozy space neighborhood. Millions of friends live together on this wonderful round world. We never fall off because our home gives us a giant invisible hug. What a peaceful and happy spaceship we share together every single day.

facts.title: Golden Morning Sunshine
facts.text: Every morning when you wake up, the warm golden sun gives our planet a big bright smile. The sunshine wakes up the sleepy flowers and warms our tiny toes. It chases away the dark night and paints the sky with pretty pink colors. Plants need this happy sunshine to grow big and strong like you. We love playing outside in the bright, cheerful daylight. The sun is like a giant glowing night-light up in the sky.

facts.title: Brave Rockets Zooming Up
facts.text: Imagine sitting inside a giant white rocket pointing straight up toward the stars. Five, four, three, two, one, blast off! Whoosh goes the rocket, zooming super fast past the fluffy white clouds. Brave astronauts wear puffy white suits to float around in zero-gravity space. They look back down at our beautiful blue and green home planet with happy tears. Someday you might grow up to be a starry-eyed space explorer too.

facts.title: Twinkling Nighttime Starry Sky
facts.text: When the sun goes to sleep, a million tiny silver sparkles light up the dark velvet sky. These twinkling stars look like friendly fireflies blinking hello from very far away. If you connect the dots with your sleepy finger, you can draw pictures in the stars. They keep watch over our quiet bedrooms while we dream sweet dreams. The night sky is a magical blanket covered in glittering diamond dust just for you.

facts.title: Changing Moon in the Night
facts.text: Sometimes the moon looks like a round silver coin glowing in the dark. Other nights it changes shape to look like a yummy yellow banana slice. The friendly moon plays hide and seek behind the gray clouds high above. It shines a gentle night-light down so the sleepy world can rest. Have you ever waved hello to the bright moon before closing your eyes? It always smiles right back down at your cozy little bed.

facts.title: Spinning Round and Round
facts.text: Our big home planet Earth is always spinning round and round like a sleepy top in space. It never stops turning, not even when you go fast asleep in your cozy bed. One whole spin takes a whole day and a whole night. When your part of Earth faces the bright sun, it is daytime for playing outside. When your part spins away from the sun, it is bedtime for sweet nighttime dreams. Isn't it amazing that you are riding on a giant spinning globe right now?

facts.title: Swirly White Cloud Blankets
facts.text: Look way up high into the big blue sky and you might see fluffy white clouds floating softly by. Did you know those soft clouds are actually part of our wonderful planet Earth? They are giant blankets made of tiny water drops hugging our world. Sometimes they look like cute little bunnies or sailing boats cruising through the air. They give us cool shade on sunny days and sometimes they tickle our noses with gentle raindrops. Our Earth wears the prettiest cloud dresses of all!

facts.title: Tall Green Tree Friends
facts.text: Planet Earth is covered in millions of tall, leafy green trees that reach up toward the warm sunshine. These friendly trees are like the lungs of our big world, taking big breaths of air. Little singing birds love to build tiny twig houses safely tucked inside their leafy branches. Squirrels love to scamper up and down their bumpy, tickly brown bark all day long. When the wind blows softly by, the green leaves dance and whisper happy secrets to each other.

facts.title: Mighty Mountains Touching Sky
facts.text: Some parts of planet Earth stretch way up high into the clouds to form mighty, rocky mountains. These giant giants are made of very old stone and wear sparkling white winter hats of snow. They stand very still and quiet, watching over all the valleys and green meadows below. Brave little mountain goats love to climb up their steep, rocky paths with happy little hooves. If you could give our whole world a giant hug, you would feel all its bumpy, wonderful mountain shoulders.

facts.title: Gently Flowing Blue Rivers
facts.text: Winding all across the green lands of our planet are long, silvery ribbons of water called rivers. They start as tiny trickles high up in the mountains and then hurry down to the sea. Fish swim happily in their cool depths, and frogs sing loud songs from the muddy banks. Animals come to take big sips of the fresh, sparkling water when they feel thirsty. Every single river is like a sparkling blue highway helping to keep our whole wonderful Earth alive and growing.

facts.title: Deep Blue Ocean Waves
facts.text: Our beautiful planet Earth is mostly covered in huge, sparkling blue oceans filled with friendly fish. Gentle waves tickle sandy beaches with a soft swish and a splash. Little sea turtles swim through warm water under the bright sunshine. Playful dolphins leap high into the air and splash right back down. The deep blue water gives our home planet its lovely color when seen from space. We can splash in the cool tide pools and look for tiny colorful shells. Earth is truly a wonderful watery home for all of us.

facts.title: Buzzing Busy Green Forests
facts.text: Lush green forests cover big parts of our wonderful planet Earth like a soft velvet blanket. Tall trees stretch their leafy arms way up high to tickle the fluffy white clouds. Tiny brown squirrels scamper up thick wooden trunks to hide their favorite acorns. Colorful songbirds sing sweet morning melodies from high up in the leafy branches. Soft green moss tickles your bare toes when you walk gently on the forest floor. Friendly little ladybugs crawl slowly across bright green leaves in the warm afternoon sunlight. Our leafy green forests keep our air fresh and clean for everyone.

facts.title: Sandy Whispering Deserts
facts.text: Warm sandy deserts are very special places on our big round planet Earth. Golden sand dunes roll smoothly like giant waves made of warm sugar cookies. The bright daytime sun shines happily down and warms the sleepy desert sand. Cute little fennec foxes twitch their giant ears to listen for tiny cricket sounds. Tall green cactus plants wear prickly coats to hold onto precious drops of water. When the sun goes down, a blanket of twinkling stars covers the quiet desert night. It is a peaceful, magical place full of warm golden colors.

facts.title: Chilly White Snowy Mountains
facts.text: High up in the sky, mighty mountain peaks wear sparkling white snow hats all year round. Fluffy white snowflakes dance gently down from the cold winter clouds to cover the ground. Playful little polar bears and fluffy arctic bunnies love to romp in the chilly white snow. Icicles hang from rocky ledges like sparkling crystal glass shining in the sun. When winter comes, we can wrap up in cozy scarves and build friendly snowmen. The snowy mountains look like giant white pillows resting peacefully against the blue sky.

facts.title: Cozy Colorful Flower Meadows
facts.text: Bright and cheerful flower meadows bloom happily across our lovely planet Earth during the sunny springtime. Red poppies, yellow buttercups, and purple daisies sway gently in the soft warm breeze. Fuzzy little bumblebees hum happy little songs as they visit each sweet-smelling blossom. Delicate butterflies with painted wings flutter softly from flower to flower like flying rainbow petals. Sweet-smelling green grass tickles your ankles while you run and play outside. Our wonderful planet Earth gives us these bright, colorful flower carpets to make us smile every single day.

facts.title: The Thumping Drum
facts.text: Put your hand right here on the middle of your chest, and feel that magic little thump. Thump, thump, thump goes your very own wonderful heart inside you. It is working hard all day long like a tiny superhero drum. When you run fast and play tag, your drum beats a little bit faster. When you sit down nice and quiet to listen to a story, it slows down to a gentle rest. Your heart is always working to keep your whole body feeling strong and happy.

facts.title: The Busy Blood River
facts.text: Inside your amazing body, your heart acts like a super busy pump for a red river. It pushes special red rivers through tiny tubes all the way down to your toes. These red rivers carry yummy food and air to help you jump high and smile bright. Then the rivers circle right back up to your heart to get a fresh breath. Every single squeeze sends a warm hug of life through your arms and legs. You have your very own magic engine inside.

facts.title: Water and Sleep Fuel
facts.text: Your hardworking heart loves when you take good care of it every single day. Drinking cool, pure water is like pouring sweet fuel into your wonderful body engine. Eating crunchy apples and bright carrots gives your heart all the happy energy it needs. When the sun goes down and stars come out, it is time for cozy sleep. Tucking into your warm bed helps your heart rest so it can beat strong again tomorrow. You grow healthier every time you sleep.

facts.title: Feelings and Flutters
facts.text: Sometimes your heart tells you secret stories about how you are feeling inside right now. When you get a giant hug from someone you love, your heart feels warm and cozy. If you feel a little bit scared before your very first day of school, it might beat extra fast. That is just your heart telling you that you are brave and ready for an adventure. Every flutter and beat matches your big feelings. You can always trust your wonderful heart to guide you.

facts.title: Listening to the Beat
facts.text: Have you ever tried to listen to the sweet sound of a beating heart? If you gently place your ear against your mommy or daddy's chest, you can hear it. Thump-thump, thump-thump, it sounds just like a cozy lullaby song made specially for you. Your heart beats day and night, even while you are sleeping safe and sound in your bed. It never ever takes a nap because it loves you so much. What a wonderful, magical friend you have beating right inside you.

facts.title: Your Hand on Your Chest
facts.text: Place your tiny warm hand right over the middle of your chest. Do you feel a gentle little tap-tap tapping under your fingers? That is your very own hard-working heart saying hello to you right now. It beats all day long while you play with your bright yellow blocks. It even beats softly while you cuddle your fluffy stuffed teddy bear. Your heart never ever takes a little nap because it loves you so much.

facts.title: Running and Jumping Fast
facts.text: Have you ever run as fast as a zooming race car across the green grass? When your strong legs run and jump, your special heart starts to beat a little bit faster. Thump-thump, thump-thump, it goes like a happy little drum playing a fun song. It is working extra hard to send happy energy all the way to your toes. When you sit down to rest, your heart slows down its happy dance just like you.

facts.title: Music and Your Heart
facts.text: Listen very closely when sweet music plays softly in your cozy warm room. Did you know your friendly heart can actually dance to the lovely rhythm of a song? Sometimes when you hear a bouncy beat, your heartbeat matches the happy tune. It is like your inside body is singing along with your smiling mouth. Music makes your wonderful heart feel so joyful and bright all through the day.

facts.title: The Super Hug Machine
facts.text: Your magnificent heart is shaped just like a lovely valentine drawn with bright red crayons. But it is really a magical super hug machine hiding inside your ribs. Every single time it goes thump, it gives your whole body a warm invisible hug. It sends cozy feelings from your tummy all the way up to your smiling nose. You are so lucky to have such a caring helper keeping you safe and loved.

facts.title: Growing Big and Strong
facts.text: Every time you eat yummy green broccoli and drink a tall cup of water, your heart grows stronger. It grows right along with your tall legs and your clever thinking brain. Each birthday you celebrate, your amazing heart gets bigger and better at its special job. It loves watching you learn new things like tying your shoes and painting pictures. You and your fabulous heart are the most wonderful superhero team in the whole wide world.

facts.title: Your Body's Tiny Clock
facts.text: Did you know your heart has a very special job like a tiny ticking clock inside your warm chest? It never ever takes a nap, even when you are fast asleep in your cozy bed at night. It beats slow when you rest your little head on your soft pillow. It beats fast when you jump high like a happy little bunny in the sunny yard. Listen closely to the gentle thump, thump sound it makes just for you. Your amazing heart is working hard to take care of your growing body every single day.

facts.title: The Magic Oxygen Taxi
facts.text: Your heart is like a busy little driver steering a magic taxi all through your wiggly body. When you take a big breath of fresh morning air, your lungs fill up with wonderful oxygen. Your heart catches that fresh air and pumps it right down to your wiggly toes and fingers. That is how you get all the strong energy you need to paint pictures and build tall block towers. Take a deep breath right now and let your friendly heart share the fresh air all around you.

facts.title: Dancing to the Rhythm
facts.text: Have you ever noticed how your heart loves to dance along to your favorite bouncy music? When you sing a happy song or clap your hands together, your heart feels the joyful rhythm too. It beats a little faster because you are having so much fun playing with your friends. Sometimes you can feel it go thump-thump right under your palm when you give yourself a big bear hug. Your heart is always celebrating how wonderful it is to be a happy little kid.

facts.title: Water and Apple Fuel
facts.text: Your wonderful heart loves yummy healthy snacks to keep its steady drumbeat going strong all day long. When you drink a cool cup of pure water and crunch a crunchy red apple, you are giving your heart the best fuel. All those good vitamins travel through your tummy to help your heart pump happily. Healthy foods make your body feel like a zooming superhero ready for playground adventures. Munch on your fruits and veggies to keep your friendly heart smiling and dancing inside you.

facts.title: The Cozy Rest Time
facts.text: After you run fast and play tag outside, your legs might feel a little bit tired and sleepy. That is your cue to sit down in a comfy chair and rest your busy body for a little while. When you rest quietly, your heart gets to slow down its busy drumbeat and take a peaceful little breather. It is resting up so it has plenty of energy for tomorrow morning's brand new games. Give your chest a gentle pat and say thank you to your hardworking heart for always keeping you safe.

facts.title: The Sleepy Slowdown
facts.text: Did you know your special heart works even when you are sleeping in your cozy bed? While you dream sweet dreams about flying puppies, your heart slows down its busy beat. It rests just a little bit, taking nice deep breaths right along with you. It is whispering a quiet lullaby all through the dark night. When the bright morning sun wakes you up, your heart is ready to bounce again. It is the most faithful nightlight friend you will ever have in the whole wide world.

facts.title: The Exercise Cheerleader
facts.text: When you run super fast like a cheetah across the green grass, your heart gets very excited! It starts to thump-thump a happy little song inside your chest. That is your heart cheering you on while your strong legs jump and play. It pumps extra joy all through your arms so you can climb high ladders. When you finally sit down to catch your breath, your heart says good job. It is your very own built-in cheerleader helping you play hard every single day.

facts.title: The Happy Smile Thump
facts.text: Have you ever felt your heart do a tiny happy wiggle when someone gives you a big hug? That is because your heart feels all of your wonderful love and warm snuggles. When you giggle at a silly joke, your heart smiles right along with you. It beats with extra gladness because you are so safe and so very loved. Every happy feeling makes your chest feel warm and wonderfully cozy inside. Your heart keeps a special scrapbook of all your favorite joyful moments.

facts.title: The Temperature Blanket
facts.text: Your hardworking heart is also like a tiny weather maker keeping your fingers nice and warm. When you play outside in the chilly winter snow, your heart sends warm soup through your veins. It rushes cozy heat right out to your cold little toes and fingertips. But on a hot summer day, it cools you down so you can keep playing. It always knows just the right temperature to make your body feel comfortable. What a clever and magical helper living right inside your chest.

facts.title: The Steady Drummer
facts.text: Imagine a tiny drummer who never, ever takes a nap or drops his drumsticks. That tiny drummer is your heart, tapping out a steady rhythm day and night. It plays a song that goes thump-thump, thump-thump, without stopping for even one second. You can hear it best if you press your gentle ear against mommy or daddy's chest. It sounds like a secret drum playing just for you in a quiet room. Your little drummer will keep on playing while you grow tall and strong.

facts.title: The Sleepy Nighttime Lullaby
facts.text: Did you know your special heart never ever takes a nap? While you close your eyes and dream sweet dreams in your cozy bed, your heart keeps working all through the night. It pumps and pumps a gentle, quiet song just for you. This soft nighttime lullaby keeps you safe and warm until the morning sun wakes up. When you stretch and open your eyes, your helpful heart is right there waiting to play. It is the best little night watchman in the whole wide world.

facts.title: The Happy Giggle Thump
facts.text: Have you ever felt your chest do a happy little wiggle when you laugh out loud? That is your joyful heart joining in on all the fun times. When you tickle your brother or hear a very funny joke, your body gets super excited. Your heart beats a little bit faster because it is sharing your giggles with you. It loves when you are happy and smiling from ear to ear. Every time you laugh, your heart does a happy little dance right inside your tummy.

facts.title: The Brave Super Power Pump
facts.text: Your strong heart is like a brave superhero hiding right behind your ribs. When you feel a little bit shy or scared of something new, your heart is right there with you. It beats strong and steady to tell you that you can do hard things. Take a big deep breath in and let it out slow, and your heart will help you feel brave. You are growing up so strong every single day with your superhero heart cheering you on.

facts.title: The Warm Hug Blanket
facts.text: Your hard-working heart is like a warm blanket made just for your whole body. It pushes special warm blood all the way down to your wiggly toes and your cold little fingertips. When you play outside in the cool autumn breeze, your heart makes sure you stay nice and cozy. It sends warm hugs all through your blood vessels from your head to your feet. Isn't it amazing how your body takes care of you without you even asking?

facts.title: The Secret Listen Game
facts.text: Would you like to play a secret listening game with your very own body right now? Put your quiet little hand right in the middle of your chest and stay very still. Can you feel that tiny little thump-thump tapping against your palm like a secret knock? That is your heart saying hello and telling you it is working hard. You can listen to your heart anytime you want to feel calm and peaceful. It is your very own special friend that you get to keep forever.

facts.title: The Super Strength Thump
facts.text: Place your little hand right over the middle of your chest. Do you feel a soft tap, tap, tapping going on inside? That is your wonderful heart working super hard just like a busy muscle. Every single time it squeezes tight, it gives a little jump of joy. It is practicing to be strong so you can run and play all day long. Aren't you so proud of your strong, happy body?

facts.title: The Red River Journey
